lines.speaker: A
lines.text: I asked for your least fashionable coffee, and you brought the most expensive one.
lines.ipa: /aɪ ˈaskt fɔː jɔː lˈiːst fˈaʃənəbəl kˈɒfi and juː bɹˈɔːt ðə mˈəʊst ɛkspˈɛnsɪv wˌɒn/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Unfortunately, obscurity has become rather fashionable itself.
lines.ipa: /ʌnfˈɔːtʃənətli ɒbskjˈʊəɹɪti hɐz bɪkˌʌm ɹˈɑːðə fˈaʃənəbəl ɪtsˈɛlf/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Then give me whatever the delivery driver orders. He seems to know what he's doing.
lines.ipa: /ðˈɛn ɡˈɪv mˌiː wɒtˈɛvə ðə dɪlˈɪvəɹi dɹˈaɪvəɹ ˈɔːdəz hiː sˈiːmz tə nˈəʊ wɒt hiːz dˈuːɪŋ/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: A large filter coffee, no ceremony. I should have started there.
lines.ipa: /ɐ lˈɑːdʒ fˈɪltə kˈɒfi nˈəʊ sˈɛɹɪməni aɪ ʃˌʊdəv stˈɑːtɪd ðˈeə/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: The tea description says it reveals a lingering sense of place.
lines.ipa: /ðə tˈiː dɪskɹˈɪpʃən sˈɛz ɪt ɹɪvˈiːlz ɐ lˈɪŋɡəɹɪŋ sˈɛns ɒv plˈeɪs/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Would you prefer somewhere specific?
lines.ipa: /wʊd juː pɹɪfˈɜː sˈʌmweə spəsˈɪfɪk/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Ideally somewhere with a kettle and a reasonable bill.
lines.ipa: /aɪdˈiəli sˈʌmweə wɪð ɐ kˈɛtəl and ɐ ɹˈiːzənəbəl bˈɪl/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: I'll translate that as the ordinary pot for two, and spare you the landscape.
lines.ipa: /aɪl tɹanslˈeɪt ðat az ðɪ ˈɔːdɪnəɹi pˈɒt fɔː tˈuː and spˈeə juː ðə lˈandskeɪp/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: She offered to remember my order, including the oat milk, and I realised I don't want to have a usual.
lines.ipa: /ʃiː ˈɒfəd tə ɹɪmˈɛmbə maɪ ˈɔːdə ɪŋklˈuːdɪŋ ðɪ ˈəʊt mˈɪlk and aɪ ɹˈiəlaɪzd aɪ dˈəʊnt wˈɒnt tə hav ɐ jˈuːʒuːəl/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Most people find it reassuring.
lines.ipa: /mˈəʊst pˈiːpəl fˈaɪnd ɪt ɹˌiːəʃˈʊəɹɪŋ/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: I know. It felt unexpectedly like being introduced to a version of myself I hadn't approved.
lines.ipa: /aɪ nˈəʊ ɪt fˈɛlt ˌʌnɛkspˈɛktɪdli lˈaɪk bˌiːɪŋ ˌɪntɹədjˈuːst tʊ ɐ vˈɜːʃən ɒv maɪsˈɛlf aɪ hˈadənt ɐpɹˈuːvd/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: You could scandalise the system tomorrow by ordering tea.
lines.ipa: /juː kʊd skˈandəlˌaɪz ðə sˈɪstəm təmˈɒɹəʊ baɪ ˈɔːdəɹɪŋ tˈiː/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Their policy encourages reusable cups but requires staff to transfer every drink through a disposable measuring cup.
lines.ipa: /ðeə pˈɒlɪsi ɛŋkˈʌɹɪdʒɪz ɹiːjˈuːzəbəl kˈʌps bˌʌt ɹɪkwˈaɪəz stˈaf tə tɹansfˈɜːɹ ˈɛvɹɪ dɹˈɪŋk θɹuː ɐ dɪspˈəʊzəbəl mˈɛʒəɹɪŋ kˈʌp/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: So the visible cup is reusable, while the invisible one becomes rubbish.
lines.ipa: /sˌəʊ ðə vˈɪzɪbəl kˈʌp ɪz ɹiːjˈuːzəbəl wˌaɪl ðɪ ɪnvˈɪzɪbəl wˈɒn bɪkˌʌmz ɹˈʌbɪʃ/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: It makes the customer look virtuous without changing much behind the counter.
lines.ipa: /ɪt mˌeɪks ðə kˈʌstəmə lˈʊk vˈɜːtʃuːəs wɪðˌaʊt tʃˈeɪndʒɪŋ mˈʌtʃ bɪhˌaɪnd ðə kˈaʊntə/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Then the process needs challenging, not the people who've brought their cups.
lines.ipa: /ðˈɛn ðə pɹˈəʊsɛs nˈiːdz tʃˈaləndʒˌɪŋ nˌɒt ðə pˈiːpəl hˌuːəv bɹˈɔːt ðeə kˈʌps/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: I promised to share the cake, not to supervise a debate about its geometry.
lines.ipa: /aɪ pɹˈɒmɪst tə ʃˈeə ðə kˈeɪk nˌɒt tə sˈuːpəvˌaɪz ɐ dɪbˈeɪt ɐbˌaʊt ɪts dʒiˈɒmətɹi/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Your nephew has discovered that the corner piece has more icing.
lines.ipa: /jɔː nˈɛfjuː hɐz dɪskˈʌvəd ðatðə kˈɔːnə pˈiːs hɐz mˈɔːɹ ˈaɪsɪŋ/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: And apparently acquired a very principled objection to unequal treatment.
lines.ipa: /and ɐpˈaɹəntli ɐkwˈaɪəd ɐ vˈɛɹi pɹˈɪnsɪpəld ɒbdʒˈɛkʃən tʊ ʌnˈiːkwəl tɹˈiːtmənt/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Cut it differently next time. Justice may depend more on the knife than the speech.
lines.ipa: /kˈʌt ɪt dˈɪfɹəntli nˈɛkst tˈaɪm dʒˈʌstɪs mˈeɪ dɪpˈɛnd mˈɔːɹ ɒnðə nˈaɪf ðɐn ðə spˈiːtʃ/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: The manager apologised so enthusiastically that I never got to explain the mistake.
lines.ipa: /ðə mˈanɪdʒəɹ ɐpˈɒlədʒˌaɪzd sˌəʊ ɛnθjˌuːziˈastɪkli ðat aɪ nˈɛvə ɡɒt tʊ ɛksplˈeɪn ðə mɪstˈeɪk/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: You were reconciled before the offence had been established.
lines.ipa: /juː wɜː ɹˈɛkənsˌaɪld bɪfˌɔː ðɪ əfˈɛns hɐdbɪn ɪstˈablɪʃt/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Exactly. We left with warm feelings and the same wrong drinks.
lines.ipa: /ɛɡzˈaktli wiː lˈɛft wɪð wˈɔːm fˈiːlɪŋz and ðə sˈeɪm ɹˈɒŋ dɹˈɪŋks/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: A graceful apology still needs a reasonably accurate object.
lines.ipa: /ɐ ɡɹˈeɪsfəl ɐpˈɒlədʒi stˈɪl nˈiːdz ɐ ɹˈiːzənəbli ˈakjʊɹət ˈɒbdʒɛkt/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: This cafe has achieved the peculiar atmosphere of a library where nobody is reading.
lines.ipa: /ðɪs kˈafeɪ hɐz ɐtʃˈiːvd ðə pɪkjˈuːliəɹ ˈatməsfˌiəɹ əvə lˈaɪbɹəɹi wˌeə nˈəʊbɒdi ɪz ɹˈiːdɪŋ/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Everyone's quietly attending a different meeting.
lines.ipa: /ˈɛvɹɪwˌɒnz kwˈaɪətli ɐtˈɛndɪŋ ɐ dˈɪfɹənt mˈiːtɪŋ/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: I miss the old inconvenience of having to share a public room.
lines.ipa: /aɪ mˈɪs ðɪ ˈəʊld ɪŋkənvˈiːnɪəns ɒv hˌavɪŋ tə ʃˈeəɹ ɐ pˈʌblɪk ɹˈuːm/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: You may have to start by asking whether this chair is taken.
lines.ipa: /juː mˌeɪhɐv tə stˈɑːt baɪ ˈaskɪŋ wˈɛðə ðɪs tʃˈeəɹ ɪz tˈeɪkən/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: He said dinner was on him, then studied the bill as though it contained allegations.
lines.ipa: /hiː sˈɛd dˈɪnə wɒz ˈɒn hˌɪm ðˈɛn stˈʌdid ðə bˈɪl az ðˌəʊ ɪt kəntˈeɪnd ˌalɪɡˈeɪʃənz/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Perhaps he'd made the offer before seeing the wine list.
lines.ipa: /pəhˈaps hiːd mˌeɪd ðɪ ˈɒfə bɪfˌɔː sˈiːɪŋ ðə wˈaɪn lˈɪst/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: I wanted to contribute without publicly rescuing him.
lines.ipa: /aɪ wˈɒntɪd tə kəntɹˈɪbjuːt wɪðˌaʊt pˈʌblɪkli ɹˈɛskjuːɪŋ hˌɪm/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Pay for the taxi afterwards. Generosity doesn't always need an explanatory announcement.
lines.ipa: /pˈeɪ fəðə tˈaksi ˈaftəwədz dʒˌɛnəɹˈɒsɪti dˈʌzənt ˈɔːlweɪz nˈiːd ɐn ɛksplˈanətəɹi ɐnˈaʊnsmənt/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: The booking form asks whether our discussion group is commercial.
lines.ipa: /ðə bˈʊkɪŋ fˈɔːm ˈasks wˈɛðəɹ ˌaʊə dɪskˈʌʃən ɡɹˈuːp ɪz kəmˈɜːʃəl/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Does anyone pay to attend?
lines.ipa: /dˈʌz ˈɛnɪwˌɒn pˈeɪ tʊ ɐtˈɛnd/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Only in the sense that we buy coffee and endure Martin's opinions.
lines.ipa: /ˈəʊnli ɪnðə sˈɛns ðat wiː bˈaɪ kˈɒfi and ɛndjˈʊə mˈɑːtɪnz əpˈɪniənz/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: I'd put no and leave Martin outside the legal definition.
lines.ipa: /aɪd pˌʊt nˈəʊ and lˈiːv mˈɑːtɪn aʊtsˈaɪd ðə lˈiːɡəl dˌɛfɪnˈɪʃən/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: My review sounded harsher once it was written down.
lines.ipa: /maɪ ɹɪvjˈuː sˈaʊndɪd hˈɑːʃə wˈʌns ɪt wɒz ɹˈɪtən dˈaʊn/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Did you mean the staff were indifferent, or that you felt overlooked?
lines.ipa: /dˈɪd juː mˈiːn ðə stˈaf wɜːɹ ɪndˈɪfɹənt ɔː ðat juː fˈɛlt ˌəʊvəlˈʊkt/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: The second. The first makes a claim about people I barely spoke to.
lines.ipa: /ðə sˈɛkənd ðə fˈɜːst mˌeɪks ɐ klˈeɪm ɐbˌaʊt pˈiːpəl aɪ bˈeəli spˈəʊk tuː/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Then describe the experience you can stand behind and leave their motives unwritten.
lines.ipa: /ðˈɛn dɪskɹˈaɪb ðɪ ɛkspˈiəɹɪəns juː kan stˈand bɪhˌaɪnd and lˈiːv ðeə mˈəʊtɪvz ʌnɹˈɪtən/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: The premium ticket includes priority boarding, but we'll all wait in the same corridor.
lines.ipa: /ðə pɹˈiːmiəm tˈɪkɪt ɪŋklˈuːdz pɹaɪˈɒɹɪti bˈɔːdɪŋ bˌʌt wiːl ˈɔːl wˈeɪt ɪnðə sˈeɪm kˈɒɹɪdˌɔː/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: You're buying an earlier position in a later queue.
lines.ipa: /jɔː bˈaɪɪŋ ɐn ˈɜːlɪə pəzˈɪʃən ɪn ɐ lˈeɪtə kjˈuː/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: When you put it like that, the upgrade loses some of its glamour.
lines.ipa: /wˌɛn juː pˌʊt ɪt lˈaɪk ðˈat ðɪ ˈʌpɡɹeɪd lˈuːzɪz sˌʌm ɒv ɪts ɡlˈamə/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Keep the money for a seat you actually occupy.
lines.ipa: /kˈiːp ðə mˈʌni fəɹə sˈiːt juː ˈaktʃuːəli ˈɒkjʊpˌaɪ/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: The temporary bus stop has a sign explaining that this is not the temporary bus stop.
lines.ipa: /ðə tˈɛmpɹəɹi bˈʌs stˈɒp hɐz ɐ sˈaɪn ɛksplˈeɪnɪŋ ðat ðɪs ɪz nˌɒt ðə tˈɛmpɹəɹi bˈʌs stˈɒp/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: A triumph of information over usefulness.
lines.ipa: /ɐ tɹˈaɪʌmf ɒv ˌɪnfəmˈeɪʃən ˌəʊvə jˈuːsfəlnəs/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: It even gives the distance without indicating the direction.
lines.ipa: /ɪt ˈiːvən ɡˈɪvz ðə dˈɪstəns wɪðˌaʊt ˈɪndɪkˌeɪtɪŋ ðə daɪɹˈɛkʃən/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Photograph the whole approach. The isolated sign won't show how absurd it feels.
lines.ipa: /fˈəʊtəɡɹˌaf ðə hˈəʊl ɐpɹˈəʊtʃ ðɪ ˈaɪsəlˌeɪtɪd sˈaɪn wəʊnt ʃˈəʊ hˌaʊ ɐbsˈɜːd ɪt fˈiːlz/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: We have organised this trip so thoroughly that any pleasant interruption now counts as a failure.
lines.ipa: /wiː hav ˈɔːɡɐnˌaɪzd ðɪs tɹˈɪp sˌəʊ θˈʌɹəli ðat ˌɛni plˈɛzənt ˌɪntəɹˈʌpʃən nˈaʊ kˈaʊnts az ɐ fˈeɪliə/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: The itinerary has quietly become the person we're trying to please.
lines.ipa: /ðɪ aɪtˈɪnəɹəɹi hɐz kwˈaɪətli bɪkˌʌm ðə pˈɜːsən wiə tɹˈaɪɪŋ tə plˈiːz/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: I caught myself apologising to the schedule when we stopped for lunch.
lines.ipa: /aɪ kˈɔːt maɪsˈɛlf ɐpˈɒlədʒˌaɪzɪŋ tə ðə ʃˈɛdjuːl wɛn wiː stˈɒpt fɔː lˈʌntʃ/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Let's miss something deliberately before the holiday asks for a performance review.
lines.ipa: /lˈɛts mˈɪs sˈʌmθɪŋ dɪlˈɪbəɹətli bɪfˌɔː ðə hˈɒlɪdˌeɪ ˈasks fəɹə pəfˈɔːməns ɹɪvjˈuː/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: My suitcase has arrived ahead of me, which would be impressive if anyone knew where it had been sent.
lines.ipa: /maɪ sˈuːtkeɪs hɐz ɐɹˈaɪvd ɐhˈɛd ɒv mˌiː wˌɪtʃ wʊd biː ɪmpɹˈɛsɪv ɪf ˈɛnɪwˌɒn njˈuː wˌeəɹ ɪt hɐdbɪn sˈɛnt/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: So the tracking system is confident about progress and vague about possession.
lines.ipa: /sˌəʊ ðə tɹˈakɪŋ sˈɪstəm ɪz kˈɒnfɪdənt ɐbˌaʊt pɹˈəʊɡɹɛs and vˈeɪɡ ɐbˌaʊt pəzˈɛʃən/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: It says delivered, a word apparently capable of existing without a recipient.
lines.ipa: /ɪt sˈɛz dɪlˈɪvəd ɐ wˈɜːd ɐpˈaɹəntli kˈeɪpəbəl ɒv ɛɡzˈɪstɪŋ wɪðˌaʊt ɐ ɹɪsˈɪpiənt/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Ask for the location and handover record. Don't let the status become the explanation.
lines.ipa: /ˈask fəðə ləʊkˈeɪʃən and hˈandəʊvə ɹˈɛkɔːd dˈəʊnt lˈɛt ðə stˈeɪtəs bɪkˌʌm ðɪ ɛksplɐnˈeɪʃən/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: The announcement said the delay was outside their control, as though control and responsibility were identical.
lines.ipa: /ðɪ ɐnˈaʊnsmənt sˈɛd ðə dɪlˈeɪ wɒz aʊtsˈaɪd ðeə kəntɹˈəʊl az ðˌəʊ kəntɹˈəʊl and ɹɪspˌɒnsəbˈɪlɪti wɜːɹ aɪdˈɛntɪkəl/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: They may not be able to move the aircraft.
lines.ipa: /ðeɪ mˈeɪ nˌɒt biː ˈeɪbəl tə mˈuːv ðɪ ˈeəkɹaft/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Of course. But they can decide whether to explain our options while we wait.
lines.ipa: /ɒv kˈɔːs bˌʌt ðeɪ kan dɪsˈaɪd wˈɛðə tʊ ɛksplˈeɪn ˌaʊəɹ ˈɒpʃənz wˌaɪl wiː wˈeɪt/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Then ask about those decisions rather than contesting the weather.
lines.ipa: /ðˈɛn ˈask ɐbˌaʊt ðəʊz dɪsˈɪʒənz ɹˈɑːðə ðɐn kəntˈɛstɪŋ ðə wˈɛðə/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: The hire company wants a photograph proving the bicycle wasn't damaged when I returned it.
lines.ipa: /ðə hˈaɪə kˈʌmpəni wˈɒnts ɐ fˈəʊtəɡɹˌaf pɹˈuːvɪŋ ðə bˈaɪsɪkəl wˌɒzn̩t dˈamɪdʒd wɛn aɪ ɹɪtˈɜːnd ɪt/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Had they asked you to take one?
lines.ipa: /had ðeɪ ˈaskt juː tə tˈeɪk wˌɒn/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: No. The requirement appeared after the dispute.
lines.ipa: /nˈəʊ ðə ɹɪkwˈaɪəmənt ɐpˈiəd ˈaftə ðə dɪspjˈuːt/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: They can't reasonably treat an unstated ritual as evidence you failed to perform it.
lines.ipa: /ðeɪ kˈɑːnt ɹˈiːzənəbli tɹˈiːt ɐn ʌnstˈeɪtɪd ɹˈɪtʃuːəl az ˈɛvɪdəns juː fˈeɪld tə pəfˈɔːm ɪt/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: The accessible journey technically exists, provided you can arrange assistance before you know you'll need to travel.
lines.ipa: /ðɪ aksˈɛsəbəl dʒˈɜːni tˈɛknɪkli ɛɡzˈɪsts pɹəvˈaɪdɪd juː kan ɐɹˈeɪndʒ ɐsˈɪstəns bɪfˌɔː juː nˈəʊ juːl nˈiːd tə tɹˈavəl/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Spontaneity has been reserved for the people least required to plan.
lines.ipa: /spˌɒntənˈeɪɪti hˈazbiːn ɹɪzˈɜːvd fəðə pˈiːpəl lˈiːst ɹɪkwˈaɪəd tə plˈan/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: That's what the route planner doesn't capture.
lines.ipa: /ðats wɒt ðə ɹˈuːt plˈanə dˈʌzənt kˈaptʃə/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: The feedback should describe that lost freedom, not merely the additional minutes.
lines.ipa: /ðə fˈiːdbak ʃˌʊd dɪskɹˈaɪb ðat lˈɒst fɹˈiːdəm nˌɒt mˈiəli ðɪ ɐdˈɪʃənəl mˈɪnɪts/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Our driver kept describing the detour as a favour.
lines.ipa: /ˌaʊə dɹˈaɪvə kˈɛpt dɪskɹˈaɪbɪŋ ðə dˈiːtʊəɹ az ɐ fˈeɪvə/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Did he ask whether you wanted it?
lines.ipa: /dˈɪd hiː ˈask wˈɛðə juː wˈɒntɪd ɪt/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: He announced how pleased we'd be once we'd seen the view.
lines.ipa: /hiː ɐnˈaʊnst hˌaʊ plˈiːzd wiːd biː wˈʌns wiːd sˈiːn ðə vjˈuː/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: A favour generally leaves the recipient some room to decline the benefit.
lines.ipa: /ɐ fˈeɪvə dʒˈɛnəɹəli lˈiːvz ðə ɹɪsˈɪpiənt sˌʌm ɹˈuːm tə dɪklˈaɪn ðə bˈɛnɪfˌɪt/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: The refund letter began with congratulations, which I found a curious response to a cancelled journey.
lines.ipa: /ðə ɹˈiːfʌnd lˈɛtə bɪɡˈan wɪð kəŋɡɹˈatʃʊlˈeɪʃənz wˌɪtʃ aɪ fˈaʊnd ɐ kjˈʊəɹiəs ɹɪspˈɒns tʊ ɐ kˈansəld dʒˈɜːni/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Your money was being returned as though you'd won it.
lines.ipa: /jɔː mˈʌni wɒz bˌiːɪŋ ɹɪtˈɜːnd az ðˌəʊ juːd wˈʌn ɪt/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Exactly. I wasn't seeking an occasion for gratitude.
lines.ipa: /ɛɡzˈaktli aɪ wˌɒzn̩t sˈiːkɪŋ ɐn əkˈeɪʒən fɔː ɡɹˈatɪtjˌuːd/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: You can acknowledge the payment without accepting the story wrapped around it.
lines.ipa: /juː kan ɐknˈɒlɪdʒ ðə pˈeɪmənt wɪðˌaʊt ɐksˈɛptɪŋ ðə stˈɔːɹi ɹˈapt ɐɹˈaʊnd ɪt/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Everyone's comparing travel times from departure to arrival, but nobody's counting the day spent recovering.
lines.ipa: /ˈɛvɹɪwˌɒnz kəmpˈeəɹɪŋ tɹˈavəl tˈaɪmz fɹɒm dɪpˈɑːtʃə tʊ ɐɹˈaɪvəl bˌʌt nˈəʊbɒdiz kˈaʊntɪŋ ðə dˈeɪ spˈɛnt ɹɪkˈʌvəɹɪŋ/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: That depends on the traveller, though.
lines.ipa: /ðat dɪpˈɛndz ɒnðə tɹˈavələ ðˈəʊ/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Yes, which is why the fastest route isn't a universal answer.
lines.ipa: /jˈɛs wˌɪtʃ ɪz wˌaɪ ðə fˈastɪst ɹˈuːt ˌɪzənt ɐ jˌuːnɪvˈɜːsəl ˈansə/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Choose the journey you'll be able to enjoy after you've completed it.
lines.ipa: /tʃˈuːz ðə dʒˈɜːni juːl biː ˈeɪbəl tʊ ɛndʒˈɔɪ ˈaftə juːv kəmplˈiːtɪd ɪt/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: They upgraded our room to one that photographs better and functions worse.
lines.ipa: /ðeɪ ʌpɡɹˈeɪdɪd ˌaʊə ɹˈuːm tə wˈɒn ðat fˈəʊtəɡɹˌafz bˈɛtə and fˈʌŋkʃənz wˈɜːs/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: What did you lose?
lines.ipa: /wˌɒt dˈɪd juː lˈuːz/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: A usable table, a quiet corner, and the ability to reach the wardrobe without moving a chair.
lines.ipa: /ɐ jˈuːzəbəl tˈeɪbəl ɐ kwˈaɪət kˈɔːnə and ðɪ ɐbˈɪləti tə ɹˈiːtʃ ðə wˈɔːdɹəʊb wɪðˌaʊt mˈuːvɪŋ ɐ tʃˈeə/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Then decline the prestige and ask for the practical things you actually booked.
lines.ipa: /ðˈɛn dɪklˈaɪn ðə pɹɛstˈiːʒ and ˈask fəðə pɹˈaktɪkəl θˈɪŋz juː ˈaktʃuːəli bˈʊkt/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: The breakfast host kept insisting we try everything, which made leaving one dish untouched feel like a diplomatic incident.
lines.ipa: /ðə bɹˈɛkfəst hˈəʊst kˈɛpt ɪnsˈɪstɪŋ wiː tɹˈaɪ ˈɛvɹɪθˌɪŋ wˌɪtʃ mˌeɪd lˈiːvɪŋ wˈɒn dˈɪʃ ʌntˈʌtʃt fˈiːl lˈaɪk ɐ dˌɪpləmˈatɪk ˈɪnsɪdənt/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Perhaps enthusiasm was being mistaken for hospitality.
lines.ipa: /pəhˈaps ɛnθjˈuːziˌazəm wɒz bˌiːɪŋ mɪstˈeɪkən fɔː hˌɒspɪtˈalɪti/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: We'd have felt more welcome if no one had monitored how thoroughly we enjoyed ourselves.
lines.ipa: /wiːd hav fˈɛlt mˈɔː wˈɛlkʌm ɪf nˈəʊwˈɒn had mˈɒnɪtəd hˌaʊ θˈʌɹəli wiː ɛndʒˈɔɪd aʊəsˈɛlvz/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: There's an art to offering abundance without turning it into an obligation.
lines.ipa: /ðeəz ɐn ˈɑːt tʊ ˈɒfəɹɪŋ ɐbˈʌndəns wɪðˌaʊt tˈɜːnɪŋ ɪt ˌɪntʊ ɐn ˌɒblɪɡˈeɪʃən/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: The room description calls the street lively.
lines.ipa: /ðə ɹˈuːm dɪskɹˈɪpʃən kˈɔːlz ðə stɹˈiːt lˈaɪvlɪ/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: A word that sounds rather different at three in the morning.
lines.ipa: /ɐ wˈɜːd ðat sˈaʊndz ɹˈɑːðə dˈɪfɹənt at θɹˈiː ɪnðə mˈɔːnɪŋ/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Exactly. I admired the wording more before I heard the delivery lorries.
lines.ipa: /ɛɡzˈaktli aɪ ɐdmˈaɪəd ðə wˈɜːdɪŋ mˈɔː bɪfˌɔːɹ aɪ hˈɜːd ðə dɪlˈɪvəɹi lˈɒɹiz/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Mention the timing. Lively isn't necessarily misleading until it conceals what a guest needs to know.
lines.ipa: /mˈɛnʃən ðə tˈaɪmɪŋ lˈaɪvlɪ ˌɪzənt nˌɛsɪsˈɛɹɪli mɪslˈiːdɪŋ ʌntˈɪl ɪt kənsˈiːlz wɒt ɐ ɡˈɛst nˈiːdz tə nˈəʊ/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: The late-checkout offer is complimentary once you buy the package that includes it.
lines.ipa: /ðə lˈeɪttʃˈɛkaʊt ˈɒfəɹ ɪz kˌɒmplɪmˈɛntəɹi wˈʌns juː bˈaɪ ðə pˈakɪdʒ ðat ɪŋklˈuːdz ɪt/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Then it's included, rather than freely given.
lines.ipa: /ðˈɛn ɪts ɪŋklˈuːdɪd ɹˈɑːðə ðɐn fɹˈiːli ɡˈɪvən/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: The distinction vanished somewhere between the brochure and the reception desk.
lines.ipa: /ðə dɪstˈɪŋkʃən vˈanɪʃt sˈʌmweə bɪtwˌiːn ðə bɹˈəʊʃə and ðə ɹɪsˈɛpʃən dˈɛsk/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Ask for the actual additional cost and let the adjective retire.
lines.ipa: /ˈask fəðɪ ˈaktʃuːəl ɐdˈɪʃənəl kˈɒst and lˈɛt ðɪ ˈadʒɪktˌɪv ɹɪtˈaɪə/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: I returned the charger and received a thank-you message accusing me of having failed to return it.
lines.ipa: /aɪ ɹɪtˈɜːnd ðə tʃˈɑːdʒə and ɹɪsˈiːvd ɐ θˈaŋkjuː mˈɛsɪdʒ ɐkjˈuːzɪŋ mˌiː ɒv hˌavɪŋ fˈeɪld tə ɹɪtˈɜːn ɪt/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: An ambitious piece of automated correspondence.
lines.ipa: /ɐn ambˈɪʃəs pˈiːs ɒv ˈɔːtəmˌeɪtɪd kˌɒɹɪspˈɒndəns/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: The receptionist says not to worry, but the deposit is still being held.
lines.ipa: /ðə ɹɪsˈɛpʃənˌɪst sˈɛz nˌɒt tə wˈʌɹi bˌʌt ðə dɪpˈɒzɪt ɪz stˈɪl bˌiːɪŋ hˈɛld/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: A reassuring conversation needs to be followed by a corrected record.
lines.ipa: /ɐ ɹˌiːəʃˈʊəɹɪŋ kɒnvəsˈeɪʃən nˈiːdz təbi fˈɒləʊd baɪ ɐ kəɹˈɛktɪd ɹˈɛkɔːd/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: The laundry apologised for the damaged lining and offered to restore my confidence.
lines.ipa: /ðə lˈɔːndɹi ɐpˈɒlədʒˌaɪzd fəðə dˈamɪdʒd lˈaɪnɪŋ and ˈɒfəd tə ɹɪstˈɔː maɪ kˈɒnfɪdəns/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: I'd start with the lining.
lines.ipa: /aɪd stˈɑːt wɪððə lˈaɪnɪŋ/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: That was more or less my answer, though I tried to make it sound less pointed.
lines.ipa: /ðat wɒz mˈɔː ɔː lˈɛs maɪ ˈansə ðˌəʊ aɪ tɹˈaɪd tə mˌeɪk ɪt sˈaʊnd lˈɛs pˈɔɪntɪd/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Concrete repairs are often a promising route to the more abstract ones.
lines.ipa: /kˈɒŋkɹiːt ɹɪpˈeəz ɑːɹ ˈɒfən ɐ pɹˈɒmɪsɪŋ ɹˈuːt tə ðə mˈɔːɹ ˈabstɹakt wˌɒnz/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: The hotel says the booking is flexible, by which it means I may choose freely among dates I cannot use.
lines.ipa: /ðə həʊtˈɛl sˈɛz ðə bˈʊkɪŋ ɪz flˈɛksɪbəl baɪ wˌɪtʃ ɪt mˈiːnz aɪ mˈeɪ tʃˈuːz fɹˈiːli ɐmˌʌŋ dˈeɪts aɪ kˈanɒt jˈuːs/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Have they offered a workable alternative at all?
lines.ipa: /hav ðeɪ ˈɒfəd ɐ wˈɜːkəbəl ɔːltˈɜːnətˌɪv at ˈɔːl/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Not yet. They keep repeating the existence of choice.
lines.ipa: /nˌɒt jˈɛt ðeɪ kˈiːp ɹɪpˈiːtɪŋ ðɪ ɛɡzˈɪstəns ɒv tʃˈɔɪs/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Explain the constraint once, then ask which option meets it rather than debating the slogan.
lines.ipa: /ɛksplˈeɪn ðə kənstɹˈeɪnt wˈʌns ðˈɛn ˈask wˌɪtʃ ˈɒpʃən mˈiːts ɪt ɹˈɑːðə ðɐn dɪbˈeɪtɪŋ ðə slˈəʊɡən/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: The replacement key was handed to the person who sounded most certain about being me.
lines.ipa: /ðə ɹɪplˈeɪsmənt kˈiː wɒz hˈandɪd tə ðə pˈɜːsən hˌuː sˈaʊndɪd mˈəʊst sˈɜːtən ɐbˌaʊt bˈiːɪŋ mˌiː/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Confidence is a rather poor identity document.
lines.ipa: /kˈɒnfɪdəns ɪz ɐ ɹˈɑːðə pˈʊəɹ aɪdˈɛntɪti dˈɒkjuːmənt/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: That was my concern. Nobody checked anything that couldn't be overheard.
lines.ipa: /ðat wɒz maɪ kənsˈɜːn nˈəʊbɒdi tʃˈɛkt ˈɛnɪθˌɪŋ ðat kˌʊdənt biː ˌəʊvəhˈɜːd/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Raise the verification failure specifically. It needs more than an apology for making you uncomfortable.
lines.ipa: /ɹˈeɪz ðə vˌɛɹɪfɪkˈeɪʃən fˈeɪliə spəsˈɪfɪkli ɪt nˈiːdz mˈɔː ðˌanən ɐpˈɒlədʒi fɔː mˌeɪkɪŋ juː ʌŋkˈʌmftəbəl/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: The invoice is beautifully itemised until it reaches a substantial line marked miscellaneous.
lines.ipa: /ðɪ ˈɪnvɔɪs ɪz bjˈuːtɪfəli ˈaɪtəmˌaɪzd ʌntˈɪl ɪt ɹˈiːtʃɪz ɐ səbstˈanʃəl lˈaɪn mˈɑːkt mˌɪsəlˈeɪniəs/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Where all the precision has apparently gone to rest.
lines.ipa: /wˌeəɹ ˈɔːl ðə pɹɪsˈɪʒən hɐz ɐpˈaɹəntli ɡɒn tə ɹˈɛst/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: I can identify the small charges myself. It's the unexplained large one that needs detail.
lines.ipa: /aɪ kan aɪdˈɛntɪfˌaɪ ðə smˈɔːl tʃˈɑːdʒɪz maɪsˈɛlf ɪts ðɪ ˌʌnɛksplˈeɪnd lˈɑːdʒ wˈɒn ðat nˈiːdz dˈiːteɪl/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Ask for its components rather than another copy of the decorative breakdown.
lines.ipa: /ˈask fɔːɹ ɪts kəmpˈəʊnənts ɹˈɑːðə ðɐn ɐnˈʌðə kˈɒpɪ ɒvðə dˈɛkɹətˌɪv bɹˈeɪkdaʊn/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: The hotel's reply thanked me for allowing them to exceed my expectations.
lines.ipa: /ðə həʊtˈɛlz ɹɪplˈaɪ θˈaŋkt mˌiː fɔːɹ ɐlˈaʊɪŋ ðˌɛm tʊ ɛksˈiːd maɪ ɛkspɪktˈeɪʃənz/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Did your review say they had?
lines.ipa: /dˈɪd jɔː ɹɪvjˈuː sˈeɪ ðeɪ hˌad/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: It said they responded well after failing to meet fairly modest ones.
lines.ipa: /ɪt sˈɛd ðeɪ ɹɪspˈɒndɪd wˈɛl ˈaftə fˈeɪlɪŋ tə mˈiːt fˈeəli mˈɒdɪst wˌɒnz/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Then the reply may be polished, but it hasn't actually engaged with what you wrote.
lines.ipa: /ðˈɛn ðə ɹɪplˈaɪ mˈeɪ biː pˈɒlɪʃt bˌʌt ɪt hˈazənt ˈaktʃuːəli ɛŋɡˈeɪdʒd wɪð wɒt juː ɹˈəʊt/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: The assistant called the shirt a statement piece when I said it didn't suit me.
lines.ipa: /ðɪ ɐsˈɪstənt kˈɔːld ðə ʃˈɜːt ɐ stˈeɪtmənt pˈiːs wɛn aɪ sˈɛd ɪt dˈɪdnt sˈuːt mˌiː/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Perhaps the statement was no.
lines.ipa: /pəhˈaps ðə stˈeɪtmənt wɒz nˈəʊ/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: That was certainly the most coherent message I received from the mirror.
lines.ipa: /ðat wɒz sˈɜːtənli ðə mˈəʊst kəʊhˈiəɹənt mˈɛsɪdʒ aɪ ɹɪsˈiːvd fɹʌmðə mˈɪɹə/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: A good sale doesn't require you to be talked out of recognising yourself.
lines.ipa: /ɐ ɡˈʊd sˈeɪl dˈʌzənt ɹɪkwˈaɪə juː təbi tˈɔːkt ˌaʊtəv ɹˈɛkəɡnˌaɪzɪŋ jɔːsˈɛlf/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: The return was described as a gesture of goodwill, although the shop had already admitted sending the wrong item.
lines.ipa: /ðə ɹɪtˈɜːn wɒz dɪskɹˈaɪbd az ɐ dʒˈɛstʃəɹ ɒv ɡˈʊdwɪl ɔːlðˈəʊ ðə ʃˈɒp had ɔːlɹˌɛdi ɐdmˈɪtɪd sˈɛndɪŋ ðə ɹˈɒŋ ˈaɪtəm/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: They were presenting the correction as discretionary generosity.
lines.ipa: /ðeɪ wɜː pɹɪzˈɛntɪŋ ðə kəɹˈɛkʃən az dɪskɹˈɛʃənəɹi dʒˌɛnəɹˈɒsɪti/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: I didn't want to quarrel over language once the money was coming back.
lines.ipa: /aɪ dˈɪdnt wˈɒnt tə kwˈɒɹəl ˌəʊvə lˈaŋɡwɪdʒ wˈʌns ðə mˈʌni wɒz kˈʌmɪŋ bˈak/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: You needn't quarrel, but you don't have to mistake a remedy for a favour.
lines.ipa: /juː nˈiːdənt kwˈɒɹəl bˌʌt juː dˈəʊnt hav tə mɪstˈeɪk ɐ ɹˈɛmədi fəɹə fˈeɪvə/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: The sale sign makes the original price look like a moral failing I've narrowly escaped.
lines.ipa: /ðə sˈeɪl sˈaɪn mˌeɪks ðɪ əɹˈɪdʒɪnəl pɹˈaɪs lˈʊk lˈaɪk ɐ mˈɒɹəl fˈeɪlɪŋ aɪv nˈaɹəʊli ɛskˈeɪpt/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: And the reduced price like evidence of good judgement.
lines.ipa: /and ðə ɹɪdjˈuːst pɹˈaɪs lˈaɪk ˈɛvɪdəns ɒv ɡˈʊd dʒˈʌdʒmənt/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Exactly. I nearly bought something simply to confirm that account of myself.
lines.ipa: /ɛɡzˈaktli aɪ nˌiəli bˈɔːt sˈʌmθɪŋ sˈɪmpli tə kənfˈɜːm ðat ɐkˈaʊnt ɒv maɪsˈɛlf/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Try leaving without it. The saving becomes considerably easier to calculate.
lines.ipa: /tɹˈaɪ lˈiːvɪŋ wɪðˈaʊt ɪt ðə sˈeɪvɪŋ bɪkˌʌmz kənsˈɪdəɹəbli ˈiːziə tə kˈalkjʊlˌeɪt/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: The technician described the fault as cosmetic, though it changes how the screen can be read.
lines.ipa: /ðə tɛknˈɪʃən dɪskɹˈaɪbd ðə fˈɒlt az kɒzmˈɛtɪk ðˌəʊ ɪt tʃˈeɪndʒɪz hˌaʊ ðə skɹˈiːn kan biː ɹˈɛd/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: So the classification is doing more than the inspection.
lines.ipa: /sˌəʊ ðə klˌasɪfɪkˈeɪʃən ɪz dˌuːɪŋ mˈɔː ðɐn ðɪ ɪnspˈɛkʃən/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: It seems designed to make my use of the product sound unusually demanding.
lines.ipa: /ɪt sˈiːmz dɪzˈaɪnd tə mˌeɪk maɪ jˈuːs ɒvðə pɹˈɒdʌkt sˈaʊnd ʌnjˈuːʒuːəli dɪmˈandɪŋ/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Show the task affected. A label shouldn't settle the practical consequence.
lines.ipa: /ʃˈəʊ ðə tˈask ɐfˈɛktɪd ɐ lˈeɪbəl ʃˌʊdənt sˈɛtəl ðə pɹˈaktɪkəl kˈɒnsɪkwəns/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: The collection desk says the parcel is ready, while the warehouse says ready means awaiting dispatch.
lines.ipa: /ðə kəlˈɛkʃən dˈɛsk sˈɛz ðə pˈɑːsəl ɪz ɹˈɛdi wˌaɪl ðə wˈeəhaʊs sˈɛz ɹˈɛdi mˈiːnz ɐwˈeɪtɪŋ dɪspˈatʃ/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Two departments sharing a word and not a definition.
lines.ipa: /tˈuː dɪpˈɑːtmənts ʃˈeəɹɪŋ ɐ wˈɜːd and nˌɒtə dˌɛfɪnˈɪʃən/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Meanwhile I'm standing between them with an extremely real empty bag.
lines.ipa: /mˈiːnwaɪl aɪm stˈandɪŋ bɪtwˌiːn ðˌɛm wɪð ɐn ɛkstɹˈiːmli ɹˈiəl ˈɛmpti bˈaɡ/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Ask someone to take ownership of the handover rather than relay another status.
lines.ipa: /ˈask sˈʌmwɒn tə tˈeɪk ˈəʊnəʃˌɪp ɒvðə hˈandəʊvə ɹˈɑːðə ðɐn ɹˈiːleɪ ɐnˈʌðə stˈeɪtəs/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: I chose gift wrapping because I wanted the present to look effortless.
lines.ipa: /aɪ tʃˈəʊz ɡˈɪft ɹˈapɪŋ bɪkˈɒz aɪ wˈɒntɪd ðə pɹˈɛzənt tə lˈʊk ˈɛfətləs/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: You paid someone else to make the effort invisible.
lines.ipa: /juː pˈeɪd sˈʌmwɒn ˈɛls tə mˌeɪk ðɪ ˈɛfət ɪnvˈɪzɪbəl/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Precisely. Unfortunately, the packaging included a leaflet advertising that very service.
lines.ipa: /pɹɪsˈaɪsli ʌnfˈɔːtʃənətli ðə pˈakɪdʒɪŋ ɪŋklˈuːdɪd ɐ lˈiːflɪt ˈadvətˌaɪzɪŋ ðat vˈɛɹi sˈɜːvɪs/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Take the leaflet out. The gift can survive a small loss of documentary completeness.
lines.ipa: /tˈeɪk ðə lˈiːflɪt ˈaʊt ðə ɡˈɪft kan səvˈaɪv ɐ smˈɔːl lˈɒs ɒv dˌɒkjuːmˈɛntəɹi kəmplˈiːtnəs/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: The voucher is so restrictive that spending it has become the purchase.
lines.ipa: /ðə vˈaʊtʃəɹ ɪz sˌəʊ ɹɪstɹˈɪktɪv ðat spˈɛndɪŋ ɪt hɐz bɪkˌʌm ðə pˈɜːtʃɪs/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: You've acquired a project rather than a discount.
lines.ipa: /juːv ɐkwˈaɪəd ɐ pɹˈɒdʒɛkt ɹˈɑːðə ðˌanə dˈɪskaʊnt/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: And I keep adding things to qualify for an offer I didn't need.
lines.ipa: /and aɪ kˈiːp ˈadɪŋ θˈɪŋz tə kwˈɒlɪfˌaɪ fəɹən ˈɒfəɹ aɪ dˈɪdnt nˈiːd/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Let it expire if necessary. Sunk enthusiasm isn't a reason to spend more money.
lines.ipa: /lˈɛt ɪt ɛkspˈaɪə ɪf nˈɛsɪsəɹi sˈʌŋk ɛnθjˈuːziˌazəm ˌɪzənt ɐ ɹˈiːzən tə spˈɛnd mˈɔː mˈʌni/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: The restored table is advertised as having an authentic history, but the seller can't tell me anything about it.
lines.ipa: /ðə ɹɪstˈɔːd tˈeɪbəl ɪz ˈadvətˌaɪzd az hˌavɪŋ ɐn ɔːθˈɛntɪk hˈɪstəɹi bˌʌt ðə sˈɛlə kˈɑːnt tˈɛl mˌiː ˈɛnɪθˌɪŋ ɐbˈaʊt ɪt/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Then history may mean visible scratches rather than established provenance.
lines.ipa: /ðˈɛn hˈɪstəɹi mˈeɪ mˈiːn vˈɪzɪbəl skɹˈatʃɪz ɹˈɑːðə ðɐn ɪstˈablɪʃt pɹˈuːvnəns/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: I like the scratches. I just don't want to pay for an invented biography.
lines.ipa: /aɪ lˈaɪk ðə skɹˈatʃɪz aɪ dʒˈʌst dˈəʊnt wˈɒnt tə pˈeɪ fəɹən ɪnvˈɛntɪd baɪˈɒɡɹəfi/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Offer what the object is worth to you without financing the story.
lines.ipa: /ˈɒfə wɒt ðɪ ˈɒbdʒɛkt ɪz wˈɜːθ tə juː wɪðˌaʊt faɪnˈansɪŋ ðə stˈɔːɹi/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: The sustainable packaging comes in a sleeve explaining how little packaging it uses.
lines.ipa: /ðə səstˈeɪnəbəl pˈakɪdʒɪŋ kˈʌmz ɪn ɐ slˈiːv ɛksplˈeɪnɪŋ hˌaʊ lˈɪtəl pˈakɪdʒɪŋ ɪt jˈuːzɪz/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: The explanation may be undermining its own subject.
lines.ipa: /ðɪ ɛksplɐnˈeɪʃən mˈeɪ biː ˌʌndəmˈaɪnɪŋ ɪts ˈəʊn sˈʌbdʒɛkt/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: That was my impression when I unwrapped the leaflet from another protective layer.
lines.ipa: /ðat wɒz maɪ ɪmpɹˈɛʃən wɛn aɪ ʌnɹˈapt ðə lˈiːflɪt fɹɒm ɐnˈʌðə pɹətˈɛktɪv lˈeɪə/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Ask what can be omitted, rather than which layer has the most reassuring label.
lines.ipa: /ˈask wɒt kan biː əʊmˈɪtɪd ɹˈɑːðə ðɐn wˌɪtʃ lˈeɪə hɐz ðə mˈəʊst ɹˌiːəʃˈʊəɹɪŋ lˈeɪbəl/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: The limited edition will never be reprinted, although a slightly different limited edition appears every year.
lines.ipa: /ðə lˈɪmɪtɪd ɪdˈɪʃən wɪl nˈɛvə biː ɹɪpɹˈɪntɪd ɔːlðˈəʊ ɐ slˈaɪtli dˈɪfɹənt lˈɪmɪtɪd ɪdˈɪʃən ɐpˈiəz ˈɛvɹɪ jˈiə/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Scarcity with a renewable supply.
lines.ipa: /skˈeəsɪti wɪð ɐ ɹɪnjˈuːəbəl səplˈaɪ/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: I wanted the book until I started feeling hurried into wanting this version.
lines.ipa: /aɪ wˈɒntɪd ðə bˈʊk ʌntˈɪl aɪ stˈɑːtɪd fˈiːlɪŋ hˈʌɹid ˌɪntʊ wˈɒntɪŋ ðɪs vˈɜːʃən/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Wait until the deadline passes. See whether the desire survives the urgency.
lines.ipa: /wˈeɪt ʌntˈɪl ðə dˈɛdlaɪn pˈasɪz sˈiː wˈɛðə ðə dɪzˈaɪə səvˈaɪvz ðɪ ˈɜːdʒənsi/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Our house meeting has become a place where everyone agrees enthusiastically with the person who cleans most.
lines.ipa: /ˌaʊə hˈaʊs mˈiːtɪŋ hɐz bɪkˌʌm ɐ plˈeɪs wˌeəɹ ˈɛvɹɪwˌɒn ɐɡɹˈiːz ɛnθjˌuːziˈastɪkli wɪððə pˈɜːsən hˌuː klˈiːnz mˈəʊst/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Does anything change afterwards?
lines.ipa: /dˈʌz ˈɛnɪθˌɪŋ tʃˈeɪndʒ ˈaftəwədz/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Only the quality of the apologies.
lines.ipa: /ˈəʊnli ðə kwˈɒlɪti ɒvðɪ ɐpˈɒlədʒiz/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Then agree who does what next, rather than holding another ceremony of appreciation.
lines.ipa: /ðˈɛn ɐɡɹˈiː hˌuː dˈʌz wɒt nˈɛkst ɹˈɑːðə ðɐn hˈəʊldɪŋ ɐnˈʌðə sˈɛɹɪməni ɒv ɐpɹˌiːʃɪˈeɪʃən/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: The damp survey describes the wall as showing signs of historical moisture.
lines.ipa: /ðə dˈamp sˈɜːveɪ dɪskɹˈaɪbz ðə wˈɔːl az ʃˈəʊɪŋ sˈaɪnz ɒv hɪstˈɒɹɪkəl mˈɔɪstʃə/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Is the moisture historical, or is the wall still wet?
lines.ipa: /ɪz ðə mˈɔɪstʃə hɪstˈɒɹɪkəl ɔːɹ ɪz ðə wˈɔːl stˈɪl wˈɛt/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: The wall seems unaware that the matter has been assigned to the past.
lines.ipa: /ðə wˈɔːl sˈiːmz ˌʌnəwˈeə ðatðə mˈatə hˈazbiːn ɐsˈaɪnd tə ðə pˈast/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Ask what measurements distinguish an old stain from an active problem.
lines.ipa: /ˈask wɒt mˈɛʒəmənts dɪstˈɪŋɡwɪʃ ɐn ˈəʊld stˈeɪn fɹɒm ɐn ˈaktɪv pɹˈɒbləm/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: I offered to lend the ladder, not to absorb everyone's interpretation of what normal wear means.
lines.ipa: /aɪ ˈɒfəd tə lˈɛnd ðə lˈadə nˌɒt tʊ ɐbsˈɔːb ˈɛvɹɪwˌɒnz ɪntˌɜːpɹɪtˈeɪʃən ɒv wɒt nˈɔːməl wˈeə mˈiːnz/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Has returning it become an argument about the condition it left in?
lines.ipa: /hɐz ɹɪtˈɜːnɪŋ ɪt bɪkˌʌm ɐn ˈɑːɡjuːmənt ɐbˌaʊt ðə kəndˈɪʃən ɪt lˈɛft ˈɪn/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Yes, though we both know the real disagreement is over who should feel embarrassed.
lines.ipa: /jˈɛs ðˌəʊ wiː bˈəʊθ nˈəʊ ðə ɹˈiəl dˌɪsɐɡɹˈiːmənt ɪz ˌəʊvə hˌuː ʃˌʊd fˈiːl ɛmbˈaɹəst/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Acknowledge the awkwardness and agree the repair. The object doesn't need a verdict on either person's character.
lines.ipa: /ɐknˈɒlɪdʒ ðɪ ˈɔːkwədnəs and ɐɡɹˈiː ðə ɹɪpˈeə ðɪ ˈɒbdʒɛkt dˈʌzənt nˈiːd ɐ vˈɜːdɪkt ˌɒn ˈaɪðə pˈɜːsənz kˈaɹɪktə/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Our neighbour says accepting parcels is no trouble, then recounts each delivery with the detail of a court witness.
lines.ipa: /ˌaʊə nˈeɪbə sˈɛz ɐksˈɛptɪŋ pˈɑːsəlz ɪz nˈəʊ tɹˈʌbəl ðˈɛn ɹɪkˈaʊnts ˈiːtʃ dɪlˈɪvəɹi wɪððə dˈiːteɪl əvə kˈɔːt wˈɪtnəs/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Perhaps no trouble means more trouble than they'd like to admit.
lines.ipa: /pəhˈaps nˈəʊ tɹˈʌbəl mˈiːnz mˈɔː tɹˈʌbəl ðɐn ðeɪd lˈaɪk tʊ ɐdmˈɪt/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: I don't want to force a confession before changing the arrangement.
lines.ipa: /aɪ dˈəʊnt wˈɒnt tə fˈɔːs ɐ kənfˈɛʃən bɪfˌɔː tʃˈeɪndʒɪŋ ðɪ ɐɹˈeɪndʒmənt/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Offer to redirect future deliveries. They can accept the relief without explaining the performance.
lines.ipa: /ˈɒfə tə ɹˌiːdaɪɹˈɛkt fjˈuːtʃə dɪlˈɪvəɹiz ðeɪ kan ɐksˈɛpt ðə ɹɪlˈiːf wɪðˌaʊt ɛksplˈeɪnɪŋ ðə pəfˈɔːməns/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: The noise complaint became difficult when they asked exactly which conversation I'd heard.
lines.ipa: /ðə nˈɔɪz kəmplˈeɪnt bɪkˌeɪm dˈɪfɪkəlt wɛn ðeɪ ˈaskt ɛɡzˈaktli wˌɪtʃ kɒnvəsˈeɪʃən aɪd hˈɜːd/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: You shouldn't have to demonstrate how much you overheard to establish that sound travels.
lines.ipa: /juː ʃˈʊdəntavtə dˈɛmənstɹˌeɪt hˌaʊ mˈʌtʃ juː ˌəʊvəhˈɜːd tʊ ɪstˈablɪʃ ðat sˈaʊnd tɹˈavəlz/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: I said I'd rather not repeat private details.
lines.ipa: /aɪ sˈɛd aɪd ɹˈɑːðə nˌɒt ɹɪpˈiːt pɹˈaɪvət dˈiːteɪlz/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: That protects both your point and their dignity.
lines.ipa: /ðat pɹətˈɛkts bˈəʊθ jɔː pˈɔɪnt and ðeə dˈɪɡnɪti/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: The potential flatmate described themselves as easy-going, then listed fourteen non-negotiable kitchen rules.
lines.ipa: /ðə pətˈɛnʃəl flˈatmeɪt dɪskɹˈaɪbd ðɛmsˈɛlvz az ˈiːziɡˈəʊɪŋ ðˈɛn lˈɪstɪd fˈɔːtiːn nˈɒnnɪɡˈəʊʃɪəbəl kˈɪtʃən ɹˈuːlz/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Perhaps they meant easy-going once everyone agrees with them.
lines.ipa: /pəhˈaps ðeɪ mˈɛnt ˈiːziɡˌəʊɪŋ wˈʌns ˈɛvɹɪwˌɒn ɐɡɹˈiːz wɪð ðˌɛm/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: To be fair, the rules were more useful than the label.
lines.ipa: /təbi fˈeə ðə ɹˈuːlz wɜː mˈɔː jˈuːsfəl ðɐn ðə lˈeɪbəl/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Exactly. Specific expectations give you something real to decide about.
lines.ipa: /ɛɡzˈaktli spəsˈɪfɪk ɛkspɪktˈeɪʃənz ɡˈɪv juː sˈʌmθɪŋ ɹˈiəl tə dɪsˈaɪd ɐbˈaʊt/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: The movers packed the kettle in a box marked kitchen essentials, beneath everything else.
lines.ipa: /ðə mˈuːvəz pˈakt ðə kˈɛtəl ɪn ɐ bˈɒks mˈɑːkt kˈɪtʃən ɪsˈɛnʃəlz bɪnˌiːθ ˈɛvɹɪθˌɪŋ ˈɛls/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Essential as a category, rather than a priority.
lines.ipa: /ɪsˈɛnʃəl az ɐ kˈatɪɡəɹi ɹˈɑːðə ðˌanə pɹaɪˈɒɹɪti/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: We had beautifully organised possessions and no means of making tea.
lines.ipa: /wiː had bjˈuːtɪfəli ˈɔːɡɐnˌaɪzd pəzˈɛʃənz and nˈəʊ mˈiːnz ɒv mˌeɪkɪŋ tˈiː/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Put the first-night things in your own bag next time. Taxonomy isn't the same as access.
lines.ipa: /pˌʊt ðə fˈɜːstnˈaɪt θˈɪŋz ɪn jɔːɹ ˈəʊn bˈaɡ nˈɛkst tˈaɪm taksˈɒnəmi ˌɪzənt ðə sˈeɪm az ˈaksɛs/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: The energy report praises our household's efficiency without mentioning we were away for most of the month.
lines.ipa: /ðɪ ˈɛnədʒi ɹɪpˈɔːt pɹˈeɪzɪz ˌaʊə hˈaʊshəʊldz ɪfˈɪʃənsi wɪðˌaʊt mˈɛnʃənɪŋ wiː wɜːɹ ɐwˈeɪ fɔː mˈəʊst əv ðə mˈʌnθ/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: A fine result achieved by not being there.
lines.ipa: /ɐ fˈaɪn ɹɪzˈʌlt ɐtʃˈiːvd baɪ nˌɒt bˌiːɪŋ ðˈeə/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: I don't want to claim savings that disappear as soon as we come home.
lines.ipa: /aɪ dˈəʊnt wˈɒnt tə klˈeɪm sˈeɪvɪŋz ðat dˌɪsɐpˈiəɹ az sˈuːn az wiː kˈʌm hˈəʊm/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Compare a period of actual use before treating the figure as an improvement.
lines.ipa: /kəmpˈeəɹ ɐ pˈiəɹɪəd ɒv ˈaktʃuːəl jˈuːs bɪfˌɔː tɹˈiːtɪŋ ðə fˈɪɡəɹ az ɐn ɪmpɹˈuːvmənt/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: The agent says nobody has ever objected to that clause.
lines.ipa: /ðɪ ˈeɪdʒənt sˈɛz nˈəʊbɒdi hɐz ˈɛvəɹ ɒbdʒˈɛktɪd tə ðat klˈɔːz/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Which may mean nobody noticed it, not that everyone endorsed it.
lines.ipa: /wˌɪtʃ mˈeɪ mˈiːn nˈəʊbɒdi nˈəʊtɪst ɪt nˌɒt ðat ˈɛvɹɪwˌɒn ɛndˈɔːst ɪt/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: That's the distinction I was trying to make without sounding suspicious of everything.
lines.ipa: /ðats ðə dɪstˈɪŋkʃən aɪ wɒz tɹˈaɪɪŋ tə mˌeɪk wɪðˌaʊt sˈaʊndɪŋ səspˈɪʃəs ɒv ˈɛvɹɪθˌɪŋ/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Ask for the clause's purpose. A history of silence isn't an explanation.
lines.ipa: /ˈask fəðə klˈɔːzɪz pˈɜːpəs ɐ hˈɪstəɹi ɒv sˈaɪləns ˌɪzənt ɐn ɛksplɐnˈeɪʃən/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Our pet sitter sent such cheerful photographs that I began to suspect the dog preferred our absence.
lines.ipa: /ˌaʊə pˈɛt sˈɪtə sˈɛnt sˈʌtʃ tʃˈiəfəl fˈəʊtəɡɹˌafz ðat aɪ bɪɡˈan tə səspˈɛkt ðə dˈɒɡ pɹɪfˈɜːd ˌaʊəɹ ˈabsəns/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: A difficult complaint to put in a customer review.
lines.ipa: /ɐ dˈɪfɪkəlt kəmplˈeɪnt tə pˌʊt ɪn ɐ kˈʌstəmə ɹɪvjˈuː/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: I was delighted and faintly offended in equal measure.
lines.ipa: /aɪ wɒz dɪlˈaɪtɪd and fˈeɪntli əfˈɛndɪd ɪn ˈiːkwəl mˈɛʒə/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Keep the sitter. Your pride is a cheaper thing to repair than a miserable holiday for the dog.
lines.ipa: /kˈiːp ðə sˈɪtə jɔː pɹˈaɪd ɪz ɐ tʃˈiːpə θˈɪŋ tə ɹɪpˈeə ðˌanə mˈɪzɹəbəl hˈɒlɪdˌeɪ fəðə dˈɒɡ/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: The booking system congratulated me on choosing an appointment I selected because nothing else was available.
lines.ipa: /ðə bˈʊkɪŋ sˈɪstəm kəŋɡɹˈatʃʊlˌeɪtɪd mˌiː ˌɒn tʃˈuːzɪŋ ɐn ɐpˈɔɪntmənt aɪ sɪlˈɛktɪd bɪkˈɒz nˈʌθɪŋ ˈɛls wɒz ɐvˈeɪləbəl/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: It does attribute a surprising amount of intention to a constrained click.
lines.ipa: /ɪt dˈʌz ɐtɹˈɪbjuːt ɐ səpɹˈaɪzɪŋ ɐmˈaʊnt ɒv ɪntˈɛnʃən tʊ ɐ kənstɹˈeɪnd klˈɪk/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: I don't need encouragement. I need to know whether an earlier place becomes free.
lines.ipa: /aɪ dˈəʊnt nˈiːd ɛŋkˈʌɹɪdʒmənt aɪ nˈiːd tə nˈəʊ wˈɛðəɹ ɐn ˈɜːlɪə plˈeɪs bɪkˌʌmz fɹˈiː/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Then ask for the waiting-list process rather than another recommendation from the screen.
lines.ipa: /ðˈɛn ˈask fəðə wˈeɪtɪŋlˈɪst pɹˈəʊsɛs ɹˈɑːðə ðɐn ɐnˈʌðə ɹˌɛkəmɛndˈeɪʃən fɹʌmðə skɹˈiːn/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: The exercise instructor somehow made adapting an activity feel ordinary rather than exceptional.
lines.ipa: /ðɪ ˈɛksəsˌaɪz ɪnstɹˈʌktə sˈʌmhaʊ mˌeɪd ɐdˈaptɪŋ ɐn aktˈɪvɪti fˈiːl ˈɔːdɪnəɹi ɹˈɑːðə ðɐn ɛksˈɛpʃənəl/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: By offering alternatives before anyone had to request them?
lines.ipa: /baɪ ˈɒfəɹɪŋ ɔːltˈɜːnətˌɪvz bɪfˌɔːɹ ˈɛnɪwˌɒn hadtə ɹɪkwˈɛst ðˌɛm/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Exactly. Nobody was cast as the person holding everyone else up.
lines.ipa: /ɛɡzˈaktli nˈəʊbɒdi wɒz kˈast az ðə pˈɜːsən hˈəʊldɪŋ ˈɛvɹɪwˌɒn ˈɛls ˈʌp/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: That's thoughtful teaching: the preparation disappears, and the room becomes easier to join.
lines.ipa: /ðats θˈɔːtfəl tˈiːtʃɪŋ ðə pɹˌɛpəɹˈeɪʃən dˌɪsɐpˈiəz and ðə ɹˈuːm bɪkˌʌmz ˈiːziə tə dʒˈɔɪn/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: I've become suspicious of the phrase making time for myself.
lines.ipa: /aɪv bɪkˌʌm səspˈɪʃəs ɒvðə fɹˈeɪz mˌeɪkɪŋ tˈaɪm fɔː maɪsˈɛlf/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Because it turns time into another thing you're failing to manufacture?
lines.ipa: /bɪkˈɒz ɪt tˈɜːnz tˈaɪm ˌɪntʊ ɐnˈʌðə θˈɪŋ jɔː fˈeɪlɪŋ tə mˌanjuːfˈaktʃə/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Yes. The day already contains the same number of hours.
lines.ipa: /jˈɛs ðə dˈeɪ ɔːlɹˌɛdi kəntˈeɪnz ðə sˈeɪm nˈʌmbəɹ ɒv ˈaʊəz/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Perhaps the practical question is what you're prepared not to do with them.
lines.ipa: /pəhˈaps ðə pɹˈaktɪkəl kwˈɛstʃən ɪz wɒt jɔː pɹɪpˈeəd nˌɒt tə dˈuː wɪð ðˌɛm/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: The manager couldn't guarantee the dish, and I respected the answer.
lines.ipa: /ðə mˈanɪdʒə kˌʊdənt ɡˌaɹəntˈiː ðə dˈɪʃ and aɪ ɹɪspˈɛktɪd ðɪ ˈansə/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Even though it meant eating somewhere else?
lines.ipa: /ˈiːvən ðˌəʊ ɪt mˈɛnt ˈiːtɪŋ sˈʌmweəɹ ˈɛls/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Especially then. They were willing to lose the order rather than improvise certainty.
lines.ipa: /ɪspˈɛʃəli ðˈɛn ðeɪ wɜː wˈɪlɪŋ tə lˈuːz ðɪ ˈɔːdə ɹˈɑːðə ðɐn ˈɪmpɹəvˌaɪz sˈɜːtənti/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: That sort of honesty has a longer life than a reassuring guess.
lines.ipa: /ðat sˈɔːt ɒv ˈɒnɪsti hɐz ɐ lˈɒŋɡə lˈaɪf ðˌanə ɹˌiːəʃˈʊəɹɪŋ ɡˈɛs/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: The walking group calls itself inclusive, but treats the shortest route as a concession.
lines.ipa: /ðə wˈɔːkɪŋ ɡɹˈuːp kˈɔːlz ɪtsˈɛlf ɪŋklˈuːsɪv bˌʌt tɹˈiːts ðə ʃˈɔːtɪst ɹˈuːt az ɐ kənsˈɛʃən/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: As though everyone taking it ought to feel slightly apologetic.
lines.ipa: /az ðˌəʊ ˈɛvɹɪwˌɒn tˈeɪkɪŋ ɪt ˈɔːt tə fˈiːl slˈaɪtli ɐpˌɒlədʒˈɛtɪk/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Exactly. Some of us chose it because it follows the river.
lines.ipa: /ɛɡzˈaktli sˌʌm ɒv ˌʌs tʃˈəʊz ɪt bɪkˈɒz ɪt fˈɒləʊz ðə ɹˈɪvə/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Rename it for where it goes, not for the deficiency it's assumed to accommodate.
lines.ipa: /ɹɪnˈeɪm ɪt fɔː wˌeəɹ ɪt ɡˈəʊz nˌɒt fəðə dɪfˈɪʃənsi ɪts ɐsjˈuːmd tʊ ɐkˈɒmədˌeɪt/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: The refill campaign seems to assume the only obstacle is that people haven't been sufficiently persuaded.
lines.ipa: /ðə ɹɪfˈɪl kampˈeɪn sˈiːmz tʊ ɐsjˈuːm ðɪ ˈəʊnli ˈɒbstəkəl ɪz ðat pˈiːpəl hˈavənt bˌiːn səfˈɪʃəntli pəswˈeɪdɪd/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Are the refill points actually open when people pass them?
lines.ipa: /ɑː ðə ɹɪfˈɪl pˈɔɪnts ˈaktʃuːəli ˈəʊpən wɛn pˈiːpəl pˈas ðˌɛm/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Most are inside buildings that close before the evening commute.
lines.ipa: /mˈəʊst ɑːɹ ɪnsˈaɪd bˈɪldɪŋz ðat klˈəʊs bɪfˌɔː ðɪ ˈiːvnɪŋ kəmjˈuːt/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Then the missing ingredient may be access, rather than another poster explaining virtue.
lines.ipa: /ðˈɛn ðə mˈɪsɪŋ ɪŋɡɹˈiːdiənt mˈeɪ biː ˈaksɛs ɹˈɑːðə ðɐn ɐnˈʌðə pˈəʊstəɹ ɛksplˈeɪnɪŋ vˈɜːtʃuː/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: My break reminder interrupts me to announce that I'm behind schedule on resting.
lines.ipa: /maɪ bɹˈeɪk ɹɪmˈaɪndəɹ ˈɪntəɹˌʌpts mˌiː tʊ ɐnˈaʊns ðat aɪm bɪhˌaɪnd ʃˈɛdjuːl ˌɒn ɹˈɛstɪŋ/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: A small administrative achievement for the machine.
lines.ipa: /ɐ smˈɔːl ɐdmˈɪnɪstɹətˌɪv ɐtʃˈiːvmənt fəðə məʃˈiːn/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: I've started dismissing it with the irritation I reserve for unwanted work.
lines.ipa: /aɪv stˈɑːtɪd dɪsmˈɪsɪŋ ɪt wɪððɪ ˌɪɹɪtˈeɪʃən aɪ ɹɪzˈɜːv fɔːɹ ʌnwˈɒntɪd wˈɜːk/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Change the arrangement if it isn't helping. The reminder doesn't get to become the purpose.
lines.ipa: /tʃˈeɪndʒ ðɪ ɐɹˈeɪndʒmənt ɪf ɪt ˌɪzənt hˈɛlpɪŋ ðə ɹɪmˈaɪndə dˈʌzənt ɡɛt tə bɪkˌʌm ðə pˈɜːpəs/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: The replacement workshop was excellent, but the organiser wants me to withdraw my original complaint.
lines.ipa: /ðə ɹɪplˈeɪsmənt wˈɜːkʃɒp wɒz ˈɛksələnt bˌʌt ðɪ ˈɔːɡɐnˌaɪzə wˈɒnts mˌiː tə wɪθdɹˈɔː maɪ əɹˈɪdʒɪnəl kəmplˈeɪnt/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Did the good replacement erase the missed information beforehand?
lines.ipa: /dˈɪd ðə ɡˈʊd ɹɪplˈeɪsmənt ɪɹˈeɪz ðə mˈɪst ˌɪnfəmˈeɪʃən bɪfˈɔːhand/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: No. It showed they could respond well once the problem was raised.
lines.ipa: /nˈəʊ ɪt ʃˈəʊd ðeɪ kʊd ɹɪspˈɒnd wˈɛl wˈʌns ðə pɹˈɒbləm wɒz ɹˈeɪzd/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Then you can recognise the response without rewriting why it was necessary.
lines.ipa: /ðˈɛn juː kan ɹˈɛkəɡnˌaɪz ðə ɹɪspˈɒns wɪðˌaʊt ɹɪɹˈaɪtɪŋ wˌaɪ ɪt wɒz nˈɛsɪsəɹi/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: I reached the goal and promptly discovered I had made it a condition for being pleased with myself.
lines.ipa: /aɪ ɹˈiːtʃt ðə ɡˈəʊl and pɹˈɒmptli dɪskˈʌvəd aɪ had mˌeɪd ɪt ɐ kəndˈɪʃən fɔː bˌiːɪŋ plˈiːzd wɪð maɪsˈɛlf/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: So the achievement arrived carrying a rather unreasonable responsibility.
lines.ipa: /sˌəʊ ðɪ ɐtʃˈiːvmənt ɐɹˈaɪvd kˈaɹiɪŋ ɐ ɹˈɑːðəɹ ʌnɹˈiːzənəbəl ɹɪspˌɒnsəbˈɪlɪti/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: It couldn't sustain the feeling for more than a day.
lines.ipa: /ɪt kˌʊdənt səstˈeɪn ðə fˈiːlɪŋ fɔː mˈɔː ðˌanə dˈeɪ/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Let the goal be something you completed, rather than a verdict you have to keep earning.
lines.ipa: /lˈɛt ðə ɡˈəʊl biː sˈʌmθɪŋ juː kəmplˈiːtɪd ɹˈɑːðə ðˌanə vˈɜːdɪkt juː hav tə kˈiːp ˈɜːnɪŋ/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: The building's accessibility statement is an impressive account of what its designers intended.
lines.ipa: /ðə bˈɪldɪŋz aksˌɛsəbˈɪlɪti stˈeɪtmənt ɪz ɐn ɪmpɹˈɛsɪv ɐkˈaʊnt ɒv wɒt ɪts dɪzˈaɪnəz ɪntˈɛndɪd/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Does it say much about what visitors can actually do?
lines.ipa: /dˈʌz ɪt sˈeɪ mˈʌtʃ ɐbˌaʊt wɒt vˈɪzɪtəz kan ˈaktʃuːəli dˈuː/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Very little. Most of the examples concern features rather than complete journeys.
lines.ipa: /vˈɛɹi lˈɪtəl mˈəʊst əv ðɪ ɛɡzˈampəlz kənsˈɜːn fˈiːtʃəz ɹˈɑːðə ðɐn kəmplˈiːt dʒˈɜːniz/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: A statement of intent is a useful beginning, but a rather weak substitute for testing the experience.
lines.ipa: /ɐ stˈeɪtmənt ɒv ɪntˈɛnt ɪz ɐ jˈuːsfəl bɪɡˈɪnɪŋ bˌʌt ɐ ɹˈɑːðə wˈiːk sˈʌbstɪtjˌuːt fɔː tˈɛstɪŋ ðɪ ɛkspˈiəɹɪəns/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: The archive is open to the public, though discovering how to visit appears to require insider knowledge.
lines.ipa: /ðɪ ˈɑːkaɪv ɪz ˈəʊpən tə ðə pˈʌblɪk ðˌəʊ dɪskˈʌvəɹɪŋ hˌaʊ tə vˈɪzɪt ɐpˈiəz tə ɹɪkwˈaɪəɹ ɪnsˈaɪdə nˈɒlɪdʒ/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Access is being offered to people who already know how access works.
lines.ipa: /ˈaksɛs ɪz bˌiːɪŋ ˈɒfəd tə pˈiːpəl hˌuː ɔːlɹˌɛdi nˈəʊ hˌaʊ ˈaksɛs wˈɜːks/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: The staff are helpful once you reach the right person.
lines.ipa: /ðə stˈaf ɑː hˈɛlpfəl wˈʌns juː ɹˈiːtʃ ðə ɹˈaɪt pˈɜːsən/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Then document that route. It shouldn't remain a privilege of whoever happens to be introduced.
lines.ipa: /ðˈɛn dˈɒkjuːmənt ðat ɹˈuːt ɪt ʃˌʊdənt ɹɪmˈeɪn ɐ pɹˈɪvɪlɪdʒ ɒv huːˈɛvə hˈapənz təbi ˌɪntɹədjˈuːst/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: The assignment asks us to challenge assumptions, provided we arrive at a familiar conclusion.
lines.ipa: /ðɪ ɐsˈaɪnmənt ˈasks ˌʌs tə tʃˈalɪndʒ ɐsˈʌmpʃənz pɹəvˈaɪdɪd wiː ɐɹˈaɪv atə fəmˈɪliə kəŋklˈuːʒən/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Has the marking guidance actually said that?
lines.ipa: /hɐz ðə mˈɑːkɪŋ ɡˈaɪdəns ˈaktʃuːəli sˈɛd ðˈat/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Not explicitly. The model answers are just remarkably unanimous.
lines.ipa: /nˌɒt ɛksplˈɪsɪtli ðə mˈɒdəl ˈansəz ɑː dʒˈʌst ɹɪmˈɑːkəbli juːnˈanɪməs/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Then distinguish disagreement with the argument from failure to meet the task. You may need to ask which is being assessed.
lines.ipa: /ðˈɛn dɪstˈɪŋɡwɪʃ dˌɪsɐɡɹˈiːmənt wɪððɪ ˈɑːɡjuːmənt fɹɒm fˈeɪliə tə mˈiːt ðə tˈask juː mˈeɪ nˈiːd tʊ ˈask wˌɪtʃ ɪz bˌiːɪŋ ɐsˈɛst/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Our study group became less impressive and more useful once we admitted what we hadn't understood.
lines.ipa: /ˌaʊə stˈʌdi ɡɹˈuːp bɪkˌeɪm lˈɛs ɪmpɹˈɛsɪv and mˈɔː jˈuːsfəl wˈʌns wiː ɐdmˈɪtɪd wɒt wiː hˈadənt ˌʌndəstˈʊd/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: You stopped performing the results and started sharing the process.
lines.ipa: /juː stˈɒpt pəfˈɔːmɪŋ ðə ɹɪzˈʌlts and stˈɑːtɪd ʃˈeəɹɪŋ ðə pɹˈəʊsɛs/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Yes. Silence used to look like agreement when it mostly meant uncertainty.
lines.ipa: /jˈɛs sˈaɪləns jˈuːzd tə lˈʊk lˈaɪk ɐɡɹˈiːmənt wɛn ɪt mˈəʊstli mˈɛnt ʌnsˈɜːtənti/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: A little honest confusion can be a better starting point than a roomful of borrowed confidence.
lines.ipa: /ɐ lˈɪtəl ˈɒnɪst kənfjˈuːʒən kan biː ɐ bˈɛtə stˈɑːtɪŋ pˈɔɪnt ðˌanə ɹˈuːmfəl ɒv bˈɒɹəʊd kˈɒnfɪdəns/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: The extension policy assumes extra time restores everyone to an equal position.
lines.ipa: /ðɪ ɛkstˈɛnʃən pˈɒlɪsi ɐsjˈuːmz ˈɛkstɹə tˈaɪm ɹɪstˈɔːz ˈɛvɹɪwˌɒn tʊ ɐn ˈiːkwəl pəzˈɪʃən/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: And does it?
lines.ipa: /and dˈʌz ɪt/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Sometimes. Other times it simply moves the task into a week that's already full.
lines.ipa: /sˈʌmtaɪmz ˈʌðə tˈaɪmz ɪt sˈɪmpli mˈuːvz ðə tˈask ˌɪntʊ ɐ wˈiːk ðats ɔːlɹˌɛdi fˈʊl/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Then flexibility needs to consider where the work lands, not merely how far the date travels.
lines.ipa: /ðˈɛn flˌɛksəbˈɪlɪti nˈiːdz tə kənsˈɪdə wˌeə ðə wˈɜːk lˈandz nˌɒt mˈiəli hˌaʊ fˈɑː ðə dˈeɪt tɹˈavəlz/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: My tutor's comments were so delicately expressed that I mistook a serious criticism for an optional flourish.
lines.ipa: /maɪ tjˈuːtəz kˈɒmɛnts wɜː sˌəʊ dˈɛlɪkətli ɛkspɹˈɛst ðat aɪ mɪstˈʊk ɐ sˈiəɹiəs kɹˈɪtɪsˌɪzəm fəɹən ˈɒpʃənəl flˈʌɹɪʃ/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Politeness had obscured the priority.
lines.ipa: /pəlˈaɪtnəs had ɒbskjˈʊəd ðə pɹaɪˈɒɹɪti/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Exactly. I improved the wording while leaving the argument untouched.
lines.ipa: /ɛɡzˈaktli aɪ ɪmpɹˈuːvd ðə wˈɜːdɪŋ wˌaɪl lˈiːvɪŋ ðɪ ˈɑːɡjuːmənt ʌntˈʌtʃt/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Ask which issue must be resolved for the work to succeed. Tact doesn't have to make importance invisible.
lines.ipa: /ˈask wˌɪtʃ ˈɪʃuː mˈʌst biː ɹɪzˈɒlvd fəðə wˈɜːk tə səksˈiːd tˈakt dˈʌzənt hav tə mˌeɪk ɪmpˈɔːtəns ɪnvˈɪzɪbəl/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: The course promises to transform how I think, but won't show me a complete lesson.
lines.ipa: /ðə kˈɔːs pɹˈɒmɪsɪz tə tɹansfˈɔːm hˌaʊ aɪ θˈɪŋk bˌʌt wəʊnt ʃˈəʊ mˌiː ɐ kəmplˈiːt lˈɛsən/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Transformation is apparently easier to advertise than to demonstrate.
lines.ipa: /tɹansfɔːmˈeɪʃən ɪz ɐpˈaɹəntli ˈiːziə tʊ ˈadvətˌaɪz ðɐn tə dˈɛmənstɹˌeɪt/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: They say the teaching has to be experienced in its entirety.
lines.ipa: /ðeɪ sˈeɪ ðə tˈiːtʃɪŋ hɐz təbi ɛkspˈiəɹɪənst ɪn ɪts ɛntˈaɪɹɪti/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Perhaps, but that doesn't explain why a concrete account of one part should be impossible.
lines.ipa: /pəhˈaps bˌʌt ðat dˈʌzənt ɛksplˈeɪn wˌaɪ ɐ kˈɒŋkɹiːt ɐkˈaʊnt ɒv wˈɒn pˈɑːt ʃˌʊd biː ɪmpˈɒsɪbəl/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: The audience laughed at a point I'd meant sincerely, and I nearly followed them into making a joke of it.
lines.ipa: /ðɪ ˈɔːdiəns lˈaft atə pˈɔɪnt aɪd mˈɛnt sɪnsˈiəli and aɪ nˌiəli fˈɒləʊd ðˌɛm ˌɪntʊ mˌeɪkɪŋ ɐ dʒˈəʊk ɒv ɪt/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: You were tempted to exchange the point for the approval.
lines.ipa: /juː wɜː tˈɛmptɪd tʊ ɛkstʃˈeɪndʒ ðə pˈɔɪnt fəðɪ ɐpɹˈuːvəl/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: For a moment, yes. Then I explained what I'd actually meant.
lines.ipa: /fəɹə mˈəʊmənt jˈɛs ðˈɛn aɪ ɛksplˈeɪnd wɒt aɪd ˈaktʃuːəli mˈɛnt/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: That takes composure. A favourable reaction isn't always the reaction your argument needs.
lines.ipa: /ðat tˈeɪks kəmpˈəʊʒə ɐ fˈeɪvəɹəbəl ɹɪˈakʃən ˌɪzənt ˈɔːlweɪz ðə ɹɪˈakʃən jɔːɹ ˈɑːɡjuːmənt nˈiːdz/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: The online course gives me control over when I watch, not over when I can ask a question.
lines.ipa: /ðɪ ˈɒnlaɪn kˈɔːs ɡˈɪvz mˌiː kəntɹˈəʊl ˌəʊvə wɛn aɪ wˈɒtʃ nˌɒt ˌəʊvə wɛn aɪ kan ˈask ɐ kwˈɛstʃən/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: So the flexibility is attached to delivery rather than dialogue.
lines.ipa: /sˌəʊ ðə flˌɛksəbˈɪlɪti ɪz ɐtˈatʃt tə dɪlˈɪvəɹi ɹˈɑːðə ðɐn dˈaɪəlɒɡ/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Exactly. The unanswered questions accumulate while the progress bar keeps celebrating.
lines.ipa: /ɛɡzˈaktli ðɪ ʌnˈansəd kwˈɛstʃənz ɐkjˈuːmjʊlˌeɪt wˌaɪl ðə pɹˈəʊɡɹɛs bˈɑː kˈiːps sˈɛləbɹˌeɪtɪŋ/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: A completed recording isn't necessarily a completed learning experience.
lines.ipa: /ɐ kəmplˈiːtɪd ɹɪkˈɔːdɪŋ ˌɪzənt nˌɛsɪsˈɛɹɪli ɐ kəmplˈiːtɪd lˈɜːnɪŋ ɛkspˈiəɹɪəns/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: The quotation is memorable partly because generations of retelling have improved it.
lines.ipa: /ðə kwəʊtˈeɪʃən ɪz mˈɛməɹəbəl pˈɑːtli bɪkˈɒz dʒˌɛnəɹˈeɪʃənz ɒv ɹɪtˈɛlɪŋ hav ɪmpɹˈuːvd ɪt/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Which makes it attractive for an essay and difficult as evidence.
lines.ipa: /wˌɪtʃ mˌeɪks ɪt ɐtɹˈaktɪv fəɹən ˈɛseɪ and dˈɪfɪkəlt az ˈɛvɪdəns/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: I can trace the sentiment, but not those elegant exact words.
lines.ipa: /aɪ kan tɹˈeɪs ðə sˈɛntɪmənt bˌʌt nˌɒt ðəʊz ˈɛlɪɡənt ɛɡzˈakt wˈɜːdz/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Then distinguish the paraphrase from the quotation. Admiration for the sentence doesn't establish its authorship.
lines.ipa: /ðˈɛn dɪstˈɪŋɡwɪʃ ðə pˈaɹəfɹˌeɪz fɹʌmðə kwəʊtˈeɪʃən ˌadməɹˈeɪʃən fəðə sˈɛntəns dˈʌzənt ɪstˈablɪʃ ɪts ˈɔːθəʃˌɪp/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: My revision became productive when I stopped trying to make uncertainty disappear from my notes.
lines.ipa: /maɪ ɹɪvˈɪʒən bɪkˌeɪm pɹədˈʌktɪv wɛn aɪ stˈɒpt tɹˈaɪɪŋ tə mˌeɪk ʌnsˈɜːtənti dˌɪsɐpˈiə fɹɒm maɪ nˈəʊts/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: What did you do with it instead?
lines.ipa: /wˌɒt dˈɪd juː dˈuː wɪð ɪt ɪnstˈɛd/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Marked the questions I still couldn't answer, rather than polishing around them.
lines.ipa: /mˈɑːkt ðə kwˈɛstʃənz aɪ stˈɪl kˌʊdənt ˈansə ɹˈɑːðə ðɐn pˈɒlɪʃɪŋ ɐɹˈaʊnd ðˌɛm/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: That gives the next session a purpose. A neat page can otherwise conceal unfinished understanding.
lines.ipa: /ðat ɡˈɪvz ðə nˈɛkst sˈɛʃən ɐ pˈɜːpəs ɐ nˈiːt pˈeɪdʒ kan ˈʌðəwˌaɪz kənsˈiːl ʌnfˈɪnɪʃt ˌʌndəstˈandɪŋ/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: The meeting ended with unanimous agreement because the only people authorised to disagree weren't invited.
lines.ipa: /ðə mˈiːtɪŋ ˈɛndɪd wɪð juːnˈanɪməs ɐɡɹˈiːmənt bɪkˈɒz ðɪ ˈəʊnli pˈiːpəl ˈɔːθəɹˌaɪzd tə dˌɪsɐɡɹˈiː wˌɜːnt ɪnvˈaɪtɪd/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Consensus achieved through careful attendance management.
lines.ipa: /kənsˈɛnsəs ɐtʃˈiːvd θɹuː kˈeəfəl ɐtˈɛndəns mˈanɪdʒmənt/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: The minutes won't make that distinction obvious.
lines.ipa: /ðə mˈɪnɪts wəʊnt mˌeɪk ðat dɪstˈɪŋkʃən ˈɒbviəs/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Record whose judgement was actually represented before the outcome acquires a broader authority.
lines.ipa: /ɹˈɛkɔːd hˌuːz dʒˈʌdʒmənt wɒz ˈaktʃuːəli ɹˌɛpɹɪzˈɛntɪd bɪfˌɔː ðɪ ˈaʊtkʌm ɐkwˈaɪəz ɐ bɹˈɔːdəɹ ɐθˈɒɹɪti/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: I was praised for being indispensable, then refused time to train someone to cover my role.
lines.ipa: /aɪ wɒz pɹˈeɪzd fɔː bˌiːɪŋ ˌɪndɪspˈɛnsəbəl ðˈɛn ɹɪfjˈuːzd tˈaɪm tə tɹˈeɪn sˈʌmwɒn tə kˈʌvə maɪ ɹˈəʊl/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: The compliment is protecting the arrangement that's exhausting you.
lines.ipa: /ðə kˈɒmplɪmənt ɪz pɹətˈɛktɪŋ ðɪ ɐɹˈeɪndʒmənt ðats ɛɡzˈɔːstɪŋ juː/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: That's why it no longer feels entirely complimentary.
lines.ipa: /ðats wˌaɪ ɪt nˌəʊ lˈɒŋɡə fˈiːlz ɛntˈaɪəli kˌɒmplɪmˈɛntəɹi/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Ask for a plan that makes the organisation less dependent on you. Being valued shouldn't require remaining a single point of failure.
lines.ipa: /ˈask fəɹə plˈan ðat mˌeɪks ðɪ ˌɔːɡɐnaɪzˈeɪʃən lˈɛs dɪpˈɛndənt ˈɒn juː bˌiːɪŋ vˈaljuːd ʃˌʊdənt ɹɪkwˈaɪə ɹɪmˈeɪnɪŋ ɐ sˈɪŋɡəl pˈɔɪnt ɒv fˈeɪliə/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: The office debate has turned a practical scheduling question into a declaration of personal loyalty.
lines.ipa: /ðɪ ˈɒfɪs dɪbˈeɪt hɐz tˈɜːnd ɐ pɹˈaktɪkəl ʃˈɛdjuːlɪŋ kwˈɛstʃən ˌɪntʊ ɐ dˌɛkləɹˈeɪʃən ɒv pˈɜːsənəl lˈɔɪəlti/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: People are being asked where they belong rather than what their work requires.
lines.ipa: /pˈiːpəl ɑː bˌiːɪŋ ˈaskt wˌeə ðeɪ bɪlˈɒŋ ɹˈɑːðə ðɐn wɒt ðeə wˈɜːk ɹɪkwˈaɪəz/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: And any qualified answer sounds evasive.
lines.ipa: /and ˌɛni kwˈɒlɪfˌaɪd ˈansə sˈaʊndz ɪvˈeɪsɪv/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Bring it back to specific tasks. You shouldn't need an identity position to discuss a working arrangement.
lines.ipa: /bɹˈɪŋ ɪt bˈak tə spəsˈɪfɪk tˈasks juː ʃˌʊdənt nˈiːd ɐn aɪdˈɛntɪti pəzˈɪʃən tə dɪskˈʌs ɐ wˈɜːkɪŋ ɐɹˈeɪndʒmənt/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: The manual tells staff to exercise judgement whenever the written instructions stop being useful.
lines.ipa: /ðə mˈanjuːəl tˈɛlz stˈaf tʊ ˈɛksəsˌaɪz dʒˈʌdʒmənt wɛnˌɛvə ðə ɹˈɪtən ɪnstɹˈʌkʃənz stˈɒp bˌiːɪŋ jˈuːsfəl/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Without explaining what a sound judgement would take into account?
lines.ipa: /wɪðˌaʊt ɛksplˈeɪnɪŋ wɒt ɐ sˈaʊnd dʒˈʌdʒmənt wʊd tˈeɪk ˌɪntʊ ɐkˈaʊnt/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Precisely. It delegates the decision and preserves the right to criticise any result.
lines.ipa: /pɹɪsˈaɪsli ɪt dˈɛlɪɡˌeɪts ðə dɪsˈɪʒən and pɹɪzˈɜːvz ðə ɹˈaɪt tə kɹˈɪtɪsˌaɪz ˌɛni ɹɪzˈʌlt/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Then document the criteria, not just the instruction to be sensible.
lines.ipa: /ðˈɛn dˈɒkjuːmənt ðə kɹaɪtˈiəɹɪə nˌɒt dʒˈʌst ðɪ ɪnstɹˈʌkʃən təbi sˈɛnsɪbəl/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: The revised deadline was accepted as though nobody had ever believed the original one.
lines.ipa: /ðə ɹɪvˈaɪzd dˈɛdlaɪn wɒz ɐksˈɛptɪd az ðˌəʊ nˈəʊbɒdi had ˈɛvə bɪlˈiːvd ðɪ əɹˈɪdʒɪnəl wˌɒn/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: A remarkably swift disappearance of collective memory.
lines.ipa: /ɐ ɹɪmˈɑːkəbli swˈɪft dˌɪsɐpˈiəɹəns ɒv kəlˈɛktɪv mˈɛməɹi/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: I don't want blame, but I do want to understand why we all agreed to it.
lines.ipa: /aɪ dˈəʊnt wˈɒnt blˈeɪm bˌʌt aɪ dˈuː wˈɒnt tʊ ˌʌndəstˈand wˌaɪ wiː ˈɔːl ɐɡɹˈiːd tʊ ɪt/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Frame the review around what information was available and what went unchallenged.
lines.ipa: /fɹˈeɪm ðə ɹɪvjˈuː ɐɹˈaʊnd wɒt ˌɪnfəmˈeɪʃən wɒz ɐvˈeɪləbəl and wɒt wɛnt ʌntʃˈalɪndʒd/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Our new colleague asked a question so elementary that we spent twenty minutes discovering we didn't share an answer.
lines.ipa: /ˌaʊə njˈuː kˈɒliːɡ ˈaskt ɐ kwˈɛstʃən sˌəʊ ˌɛlɪmˈɛntəɹi ðat wiː spˈɛnt twˈɛnti mˈɪnɪts dɪskˈʌvəɹɪŋ wiː dˈɪdnt ʃˈeəɹ ɐn ˈansə/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Was it elementary, or simply foundational?
lines.ipa: /wɒz ɪt ˌɛlɪmˈɛntəɹi ɔː sˈɪmpli faʊndˈeɪʃənəl/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: That's a kinder and more accurate way of putting it.
lines.ipa: /ðats ɐ kˈaɪndə and mˈɔːɹ ˈakjʊɹət wˈeɪ ɒv pˈʊtɪŋ ɪt/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Keep the question in the induction. It may be useful long after the person stops being new.
lines.ipa: /kˈiːp ðə kwˈɛstʃən ɪnðɪ ɪndˈʌkʃən ɪt mˈeɪ biː jˈuːsfəl lˈɒŋ ˈaftə ðə pˈɜːsən stˈɒps bˌiːɪŋ njˈuː/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: The disagreement became manageable once we admitted it couldn't be solved by finding better words.
lines.ipa: /ðə dˌɪsɐɡɹˈiːmənt bɪkˌeɪm mˈanɪdʒəbəl wˈʌns wiː ɐdmˈɪtɪd ɪt kˌʊdənt biː sˈɒlvd baɪ fˈaɪndɪŋ bˈɛtə wˈɜːdz/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: You were clear about the difference rather than confused about the explanation.
lines.ipa: /juː wɜː klˈiəɹ ɐbˌaʊt ðə dˈɪfɹəns ɹˈɑːðə ðɐn kənfjˈuːzd ɐbˌaʊt ðɪ ɛksplɐnˈeɪʃən/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Exactly. Calling it a misunderstanding had delayed an actual negotiation.
lines.ipa: /ɛɡzˈaktli kˈɔːlɪŋ ɪt ɐ mɪsˌʌndəstˈandɪŋ had dɪlˈeɪd ɐn ˈaktʃuːəl nɪɡˌəʊʃɪˈeɪʃən/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Clarity sometimes establishes a conflict; it doesn't always remove one.
lines.ipa: /klˈaɹɪti sˈʌmtaɪmz ɪstˈablɪʃɪz ɐ kˈɒnflɪkt ɪt dˈʌzənt ˈɔːlweɪz ɹɪmˈuːv wˌɒn/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: The report places its strongest conclusion in the appendix and its weakest assurances on the first page.
lines.ipa: /ðə ɹɪpˈɔːt plˈeɪsɪz ɪts stɹˈɒŋɡɪst kəŋklˈuːʒən ɪnðɪ ɐpˈɛndɪks and ɪts wˈiːkɪst əʃˈʊəɹənsɪz ɒnðə fˈɜːst pˈeɪdʒ/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Is that deliberate caution or accidental emphasis?
lines.ipa: /ɪz ðat dɪlˈɪbəɹət kˈɔːʃən ɔːɹ ˌaksɪdˈɛntəl ˈɛmfəsɪs/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: A mixture. Nobody wanted the opening to sound difficult.
lines.ipa: /ɐ mˈɪkstʃə nˈəʊbɒdi wˈɒntɪd ðɪ ˈəʊpənɪŋ tə sˈaʊnd dˈɪfɪkəlt/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: The opening should prepare readers for the evidence, not protect them from its significance.
lines.ipa: /ðɪ ˈəʊpənɪŋ ʃˌʊd pɹɪpˈeə ɹˈiːdəz fəðɪ ˈɛvɪdəns nˌɒt pɹətˈɛkt ðˌɛm fɹɒm ɪts sɪɡnˈɪfɪkəns/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: The efficiency proposal saves ten minutes for managers and adds an hour to every shift.
lines.ipa: /ðɪ ɪfˈɪʃənsi pɹəpˈəʊzəl sˈeɪvz tˈɛn mˈɪnɪts fɔː mˈanɪdʒəz and ˈadz ɐn ˈaʊə tʊ ˈɛvɹɪ ʃˈɪft/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Whose time appears in the calculation?
lines.ipa: /hˌuːz tˈaɪm ɐpˈiəz ɪnðə kˌalkjʊlˈeɪʃən/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Only the people who commissioned the proposal.
lines.ipa: /ˈəʊnli ðə pˈiːpəl hˌuː kəmˈɪʃənd ðə pɹəpˈəʊzəl/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Then the result describes a transfer of work, not yet a demonstrated saving.
lines.ipa: /ðˈɛn ðə ɹɪzˈʌlt dɪskɹˈaɪbz ɐ tɹˈansfɜːɹ ɒv wˈɜːk nˌɒt jˈɛt ɐ dˈɛmənstɹˌeɪtɪd sˈeɪvɪŋ/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: The handover was described as complete because every file had been transferred.
lines.ipa: /ðə hˈandəʊvə wɒz dɪskɹˈaɪbd az kəmplˈiːt bɪkˈɒz ˈɛvɹɪ fˈaɪl hɐdbɪn tɹansfˈɜːd/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Had the reasoning travelled with the files?
lines.ipa: /had ðə ɹˈiːzənɪŋ tɹˈavəld wɪððə fˈaɪlz/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Not much of it. We inherited answers without knowing which questions they addressed.
lines.ipa: /nˌɒt mˈʌtʃ ɒv ɪt wiː ɪnhˈɛɹɪtɪd ˈansəz wɪðˌaʊt nˈəʊɪŋ wˌɪtʃ kwˈɛstʃənz ðeɪ ɐdɹˈɛst/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Then completion needs to include a conversation, not merely evidence that the folder arrived.
lines.ipa: /ðˈɛn kəmplˈiːʃən nˈiːdz tʊ ɪŋklˈuːd ɐ kɒnvəsˈeɪʃən nˌɒt mˈiəli ˈɛvɪdəns ðatðə fˈəʊldəɹ ɐɹˈaɪvd/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: The security briefing ended with everyone promising never to make a mistake.
lines.ipa: /ðə sɪkjˈʊəɹɪti bɹˈiːfɪŋ ˈɛndɪd wɪð ˈɛvɹɪwˌɒn pɹˈɒmɪsɪŋ nˈɛvə tə mˌeɪk ɐ mɪstˈeɪk/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: An ambitious control, and conveniently difficult to measure.
lines.ipa: /ɐn ambˈɪʃəs kəntɹˈəʊl and kənvˈiːnɪəntli dˈɪfɪkəlt tə mˈɛʒə/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: It also leaves people unsure whether reporting an error will sound like breaking their promise.
lines.ipa: /ɪt ˈɔːlsəʊ lˈiːvz pˈiːpəl ʌnʃˈʊə wˈɛðə ɹɪpˈɔːtɪŋ ɐn ˈɛɹə wɪl sˈaʊnd lˈaɪk bɹˈeɪkɪŋ ðeə pɹˈɒmɪs/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Build the response around early reporting. A demand for perfect behaviour can make ordinary failures harder to see.
lines.ipa: /bˈɪld ðə ɹɪspˈɒns ɐɹˈaʊnd ˈɜːlɪ ɹɪpˈɔːtɪŋ ɐ dɪmˈand fɔː pˈɜːfɛkt bɪhˈeɪvjə kan mˌeɪk ˈɔːdɪnəɹi fˈeɪliəz hˈɑːdə tə sˈiː/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: The sharing link grants temporary access that nobody remembers withdrawing.
lines.ipa: /ðə ʃˈeəɹɪŋ lˈɪŋk ɡɹˈants tˈɛmpɹəɹi ˈaksɛs ðat nˈəʊbɒdi ɹɪmˈɛmbəz wɪθdɹˈɔːɪŋ/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Then temporary is a description of the original intention, not the current permission.
lines.ipa: /ðˈɛn tˈɛmpɹəɹi ɪz ɐ dɪskɹˈɪpʃən ɒvðɪ əɹˈɪdʒɪnəl ɪntˈɛnʃən nˌɒt ðə kˈʌɹənt pəmˈɪʃən/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Exactly. The review list is longer than the team itself.
lines.ipa: /ɛɡzˈaktli ðə ɹɪvjˈuː lˈɪst ɪz lˈɒŋɡə ðɐn ðə tˈiːm ɪtsˈɛlf/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Set an actual expiry where possible, and review what genuinely needs to remain open.
lines.ipa: /sˈɛt ɐn ˈaktʃuːəl ɛkspˈaɪəɹi wˌeə pˈɒsɪbəl and ɹɪvjˈuː wɒt dʒˈɛnjuːɪnli nˈiːdz tə ɹɪmˈeɪn ˈəʊpən/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: The backup dashboard is entirely green, which has become a reason not to test it.
lines.ipa: /ðə bˈakʌp dˈaʃbɔːd ɪz ɛntˈaɪəli ɡɹˈiːn wˌɪtʃ hɐz bɪkˌʌm ɐ ɹˈiːzən nˌɒt tə tˈɛst ɪt/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: The reassuring display is protecting itself from inconvenient evidence.
lines.ipa: /ðə ɹˌiːəʃˈʊəɹɪŋ dɪsplˈeɪ ɪz pɹətˈɛktɪŋ ɪtsˈɛlf fɹɒm ɪŋkənvˈiːnɪənt ˈɛvɪdəns/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Nobody wants to be the person who turns it red.
lines.ipa: /nˈəʊbɒdi wˈɒnts təbi ðə pˈɜːsən hˌuː tˈɜːnz ɪt ɹˈɛd/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: A recovery test succeeds by revealing a weakness early. Its value isn't limited to delivering good news.
lines.ipa: /ɐ ɹɪkˈʌvəɹi tˈɛst səksˈiːdz baɪ ɹɪvˈiːlɪŋ ɐ wˈiːknəs ˈɜːlɪ ɪts vˈaljuː ˌɪzənt lˈɪmɪtɪd tə dɪlˈɪvəɹɪŋ ɡˈʊd njˈuːz/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: The notification controls give each team permission to declare its messages essential.
lines.ipa: /ðə nˌəʊtɪfɪkˈeɪʃən kəntɹˈəʊlz ɡˈɪv ˈiːtʃ tˈiːm pəmˈɪʃən tə dɪklˈeəɹ ɪts mˈɛsɪdʒɪz ɪsˈɛnʃəl/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Which leaves the recipient receiving a wonderfully democratic stream of interruptions.
lines.ipa: /wˌɪtʃ lˈiːvz ðə ɹɪsˈɪpiənt ɹɪsˈiːvɪŋ ɐ wˈʌndəfəli dˌɛməkɹˈatɪk stɹˈiːm ɒv ˌɪntəɹˈʌpʃənz/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Everyone can justify their own alert; nobody owns the combined effect.
lines.ipa: /ˈɛvɹɪwˌɒn kan dʒˈʌstɪfˌaɪ ðeəɹ ˈəʊn ɐlˈɜːt nˈəʊbɒdi ˈəʊnz ðə kəmbˈaɪnd ɪfˈɛkt/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Evaluate the whole experience from the receiving end rather than approving each demand in isolation.
lines.ipa: /ɪvˈaljuːˌeɪt ðə hˈəʊl ɛkspˈiəɹɪəns fɹʌmðə ɹɪsˈiːvɪŋ ˈɛnd ɹˈɑːðə ðɐn ɐpɹˈuːvɪŋ ˈiːtʃ dɪmˈand ɪn ˌaɪsəlˈeɪʃən/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: The update was described as frictionless because all the friction had been postponed until people started working.
lines.ipa: /ðɪ ˈʌpdeɪt wɒz dɪskɹˈaɪbd az fɹˈɪkʃənləs bɪkˈɒz ˈɔːl ðə fɹˈɪkʃən hɐdbɪn pəʊstpˈəʊnd ʌntˈɪl pˈiːpəl stˈɑːtɪd wˈɜːkɪŋ/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Installation was easy; adaptation was left uncounted.
lines.ipa: /ˌɪnstəlˈeɪʃən wɒz ˈiːzi ˌadaptˈeɪʃən wɒz lˈɛft ʌŋkˈaʊntɪd/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: And the support team now carries the consequences of that distinction.
lines.ipa: /and ðə səpˈɔːt tˈiːm nˈaʊ kˈaɹiz ðə kˈɒnsɪkwənsɪz ɒv ðat dɪstˈɪŋkʃən/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Include the work after installation before repeating the claim.
lines.ipa: /ɪŋklˈuːd ðə wˈɜːk ˈaftəɹ ˌɪnstəlˈeɪʃən bɪfˌɔː ɹɪpˈiːtɪŋ ðə klˈeɪm/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: The support script kept narrowing my description until it fitted a problem I'd never reported.
lines.ipa: /ðə səpˈɔːt skɹˈɪpt kˈɛpt nˈaɹəʊɪŋ maɪ dɪskɹˈɪpʃən ʌntˈɪl ɪt fˈɪtɪd ɐ pɹˈɒbləm aɪd nˈɛvə ɹɪpˈɔːtɪd/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: So the conversation was becoming easier to categorise and less accurate.
lines.ipa: /sˌəʊ ðə kɒnvəsˈeɪʃən wɒz bɪkˈʌmɪŋ ˈiːziə tə kˈatɪɡəɹˌaɪz and lˈɛs ˈakjʊɹət/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: By the end, the agent had a neat diagnosis of something else entirely.
lines.ipa: /baɪ ðɪ ˈɛnd ðɪ ˈeɪdʒənt had ɐ nˈiːt dˌaɪəɡnˈəʊsɪs ɒv sˈʌmθɪŋ ˈɛls ɛntˈaɪəli/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Ask them to read back the original symptoms before accepting the prescribed next step.
lines.ipa: /ˈask ðˌɛm tə ɹˈiːd bˈak ðɪ əɹˈɪdʒɪnəl sˈɪmptəmz bɪfˌɔːɹ ɐksˈɛptɪŋ ðə pɹɪskɹˈaɪbd nˈɛkst stˈɛp/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: The service offers privacy as a premium feature, then describes everyone else as having chosen the standard experience.
lines.ipa: /ðə sˈɜːvɪs ˈɒfəz pɹˈɪvəsi az ɐ pɹˈiːmiəm fˈiːtʃə ðˈɛn dɪskɹˈaɪbz ˈɛvɹɪwˌɒn ˈɛls az hˌavɪŋ tʃˈəʊzən ðə stˈandəd ɛkspˈiəɹɪəns/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: A constrained purchase decision is being made to carry the language of meaningful consent.
lines.ipa: /ɐ kənstɹˈeɪnd pˈɜːtʃɪs dɪsˈɪʒən ɪz bˌiːɪŋ mˌeɪd tə kˈaɹi ðə lˈaŋɡwɪdʒ ɒv mˈiːnɪŋfəl kənsˈɛnt/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: That's what bothers me. The wording quietly settles the argument in advance.
lines.ipa: /ðats wɒt bˈɒðəz mˌiː ðə wˈɜːdɪŋ kwˈaɪətli sˈɛtəlz ðɪ ˈɑːɡjuːmənt ɪn ɐdvˈans/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Separate what people can afford from what they would prefer to permit.
lines.ipa: /sˈɛpɹət wɒt pˈiːpəl kan ɐfˈɔːd fɹɒm wɒt ðeɪ wʊd pɹɪfˈɜː tə pəmˈɪt/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: The accessibility demonstration was flawless because the presenter knew every shortcut.
lines.ipa: /ðɪ aksˌɛsəbˈɪlɪti dˌɛmənstɹˈeɪʃən wɒz flˈɔːləs bɪkˈɒz ðə pɹɪzˈɛntə njˈuː ˈɛvɹɪ ʃˈɔːtkʌt/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Expert fluency can make a difficult system look effortless.
lines.ipa: /ˈɛkspɜːt flˈuːənsi kan mˌeɪk ɐ dˈɪfɪkəlt sˈɪstəm lˈʊk ˈɛfətləs/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Our first-time user couldn't find the control that began the task.
lines.ipa: /ˌaʊə fˈɜːsttˈaɪm jˈuːzə kˌʊdənt fˈaɪnd ðə kəntɹˈəʊl ðat bɪɡˈan ðə tˈask/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Test discovery as well as operation. Knowing where everything is shouldn't be an admission requirement.
lines.ipa: /tˈɛst dɪskˈʌvəɹi az wˈɛl az ˌɒpəɹˈeɪʃən nˈəʊɪŋ wˌeəɹ ˈɛvɹɪθˌɪŋ ɪz ʃˌʊdənt biː ɐn ɐdmˈɪʃən ɹɪkwˈaɪəmənt/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: The AI summary removed the hesitations that told us how uncertain the interviewee had been.
lines.ipa: /ðɪ ˌeɪˈaɪ sˈʌməɹi ɹɪmˈuːvd ðə hˌɛzɪtˈeɪʃənz ðat tˈəʊld ˌʌs hˌaʊ ʌnsˈɜːtən ðɪ ˈɪntəvjˌuːiː hɐdbɪn/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: It improved the prose at the expense of the evidence.
lines.ipa: /ɪt ɪmpɹˈuːvd ðə pɹˈəʊz at ðɪ ɛkspˈɛns ɒvðɪ ˈɛvɪdəns/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Exactly. A tentative recollection emerged as a confident statement of fact.
lines.ipa: /ɛɡzˈaktli ɐ tˈɛntətˌɪv ɹˌɛkəlˈɛkʃən ɪmˈɜːdʒd az ɐ kˈɒnfɪdənt stˈeɪtmənt ɒv fˈakt/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Preserve the uncertainty when it affects the meaning. Fluency isn't a neutral edit.
lines.ipa: /pɹɪzˈɜːv ðɪ ʌnsˈɜːtənti wɛn ɪt ɐfˈɛkts ðə mˈiːnɪŋ flˈuːənsi ˌɪzənt ɐ njˈuːtɹəl ˈɛdɪt/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: The cancellation journey asks me to confirm that I wish to lose my benefits.
lines.ipa: /ðə kˌansɪlˈeɪʃən dʒˈɜːni ˈasks mˌiː tə kənfˈɜːm ðat aɪ wˈɪʃ tə lˈuːz maɪ bˈɛnɪfˌɪts/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: It treats departure as a mistake I'm obliged to acknowledge.
lines.ipa: /ɪt tɹˈiːts dɪpˈɑːtʃəɹ az ɐ mɪstˈeɪk aɪm əblˈaɪdʒd tʊ ɐknˈɒlɪdʒ/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: I merely no longer need the service.
lines.ipa: /aɪ mˈiəli nˌəʊ lˈɒŋɡə nˈiːd ðə sˈɜːvɪs/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Then a neutral statement of the consequences would be more honest than a series of emotionally loaded reversals.
lines.ipa: /ðˈɛn ɐ njˈuːtɹəl stˈeɪtmənt ɒvðə kˈɒnsɪkwənsɪz wʊd biː mˈɔːɹ ˈɒnɪst ðˌanə sˈiəɹiz ɒv ɪmˈəʊʃənəli lˈəʊdɪd ɹɪvˈɜːsəlz/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: The recycling figures improved after several difficult materials stopped being counted.
lines.ipa: /ðə ɹɪsˈaɪklɪŋ fˈɪɡəz ɪmpɹˈuːvd ˈaftə sˈɛvɹəl dˈɪfɪkəlt mətˈiəɹiəlz stˈɒpt bˌiːɪŋ kˈaʊntɪd/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: The system became more successful by redefining the troublesome part of the task.
lines.ipa: /ðə sˈɪstəm bɪkˌeɪm mˈɔː səksˈɛsfəl baɪ ɹˌiːdɪfˈaɪnɪŋ ðə tɹˈʌbəlsˌʌm pˈɑːt ɒvðə tˈask/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: The new definition may be sensible, but the comparison isn't.
lines.ipa: /ðə njˈuː dˌɛfɪnˈɪʃən mˈeɪ biː sˈɛnsɪbəl bˌʌt ðə kəmpˈaɹɪsən ˈɪzənt/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Publish both measures during the transition. A better category shouldn't manufacture an improvement.
lines.ipa: /pˈʌblɪʃ bˈəʊθ mˈɛʒəz djˈʊəɹɪŋ ðə tɹansˈɪʃən ɐ bˈɛtə kˈatɪɡəɹi ʃˌʊdənt mˌanjuːfˈaktʃəɹ ɐn ɪmpɹˈuːvmənt/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: The water-saving award recognises the building, while the people changing their routines remain unnamed.
lines.ipa: /ðə wˈɔːtəsˈeɪvɪŋ ɐwˈɔːd ɹˈɛkəɡnˌaɪzɪz ðə bˈɪldɪŋ wˌaɪl ðə pˈiːpəl tʃˈeɪndʒɪŋ ðeə ɹuːtˈiːnz ɹɪmˈeɪn ʌnnˈeɪmd/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Perhaps the certificate is easier to attach to a wall than to a collective effort.
lines.ipa: /pəhˈaps ðə sətˈɪfɪkət ɪz ˈiːziə tʊ ɐtˈatʃ tʊ ɐ wˈɔːl ðɐn tʊ ɐ kəlˈɛktɪv ˈɛfət/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: True, but the story makes the equipment seem entirely responsible.
lines.ipa: /tɹˈuː bˌʌt ðə stˈɔːɹi mˌeɪks ðɪ ɪkwˈɪpmənt sˈiːm ɛntˈaɪəli ɹɪspˈɒnsɪbəl/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Credit the practices that make the equipment useful, or the next installation may disappoint.
lines.ipa: /kɹˈɛdɪt ðə pɹˈaktɪsɪz ðat mˌeɪk ðɪ ɪkwˈɪpmənt jˈuːsfəl ɔː ðə nˈɛkst ˌɪnstəlˈeɪʃən mˈeɪ dˌɪsɐpˈɔɪnt/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: The tree scheme is celebrated for how many saplings leave the nursery, not how many establish roots.
lines.ipa: /ðə tɹˈiː skˈiːm ɪz sˈɛləbɹˌeɪtɪd fɔː hˌaʊ mˈɛni sˈaplɪŋz lˈiːv ðə nˈɜːsəɹi nˌɒt hˌaʊ mˈɛni ɪstˈablɪʃ ɹˈuːts/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Distribution is being mistaken for a durable outcome.
lines.ipa: /dˌɪstɹɪbjˈuːʃən ɪz bˌiːɪŋ mɪstˈeɪkən fəɹə djˈʊəɹəbəl ˈaʊtkʌm/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: And nobody's budget extends far enough to count survival properly.
lines.ipa: /and nˈəʊbɒdiz bˈʌdʒɪt ɛkstˈɛndz fˈɑːɹ ɪnˈʌf tə kˈaʊnt səvˈaɪvəl pɹˈɒpəli/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Then the celebrated number should be described as a beginning, with the continuing obligation made explicit.
lines.ipa: /ðˈɛn ðə sˈɛləbɹˌeɪtɪd nˈʌmbə ʃˌʊd biː dɪskɹˈaɪbd az ɐ bɪɡˈɪnɪŋ wɪððə kəntˈɪnjuːɪŋ ˌɒblɪɡˈeɪʃən mˌeɪd ɛksplˈɪsɪt/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: The park cleanup has become an annual proof that residents care.
lines.ipa: /ðə pˈɑːk klˈiːnʌp hɐz bɪkˌʌm ɐn ˈanjuːəl pɹˈuːf ðat ɹˈɛzɪdənts kˈeə/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Do people who can't attend get treated as caring less?
lines.ipa: /dˈuː pˈiːpəl hˌuː kˈɑːnt ɐtˈɛnd ɡɛt tɹˈiːtɪd az kˈeəɹɪŋ lˈɛs/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Sometimes, despite contributing quietly throughout the year.
lines.ipa: /sˈʌmtaɪmz dɪspˈaɪt kəntɹˈɪbjuːtɪŋ kwˈaɪətli θɹuːˈaʊt ðə jˈiə/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: An event can make commitment visible without becoming the only recognised form of it.
lines.ipa: /ɐn ɪvˈɛnt kan mˌeɪk kəmˈɪtmənt vˈɪzɪbəl wɪðˌaʊt bɪkˈʌmɪŋ ðɪ ˈəʊnli ɹˈɛkəɡnˌaɪzd fˈɔːm ɒv ɪt/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: The local market's branding promises discovery, but the selection committee keeps choosing familiar sellers.
lines.ipa: /ðə lˈəʊkəl mˈɑːkɪts bɹˈandɪŋ pɹˈɒmɪsɪz dɪskˈʌvəɹi bˌʌt ðə sɪlˈɛkʃən kəmˈɪti kˈiːps tʃˈuːzɪŋ fəmˈɪliə sˈɛləz/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: They want novelty with an established record of being unremarkable.
lines.ipa: /ðeɪ wˈɒnt nˈɒvəlti wɪð ɐn ɪstˈablɪʃt ɹˈɛkɔːd ɒv bˌiːɪŋ ˌʌnɹɪmˈɑːkəbəl/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Exactly. Newcomers are encouraged right up to the point where someone has to take a small risk.
lines.ipa: /ɛɡzˈaktli njˈuːkʌməz ɑːɹ ɛŋkˈʌɹɪdʒd ɹˈaɪt ˌʌp tə ðə pˈɔɪnt wˌeə sˈʌmwɒn hɐz tə tˈeɪk ɐ smˈɔːl ɹˈɪsk/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Reserve a few spaces for experiments and judge them as experiments, not as failed institutions.
lines.ipa: /ɹɪzˈɜːv ɐ fjˈuː spˈeɪsɪz fɔːɹ ɛkspˈɛɹɪmənts and dʒˈʌdʒ ðˌɛm az ɛkspˈɛɹɪmənts nˌɒt az fˈeɪld ˌɪnstɪtjˈuːʃənz/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: The sharing scheme has solved ownership by creating an elaborate problem of stewardship.
lines.ipa: /ðə ʃˈeəɹɪŋ skˈiːm hɐz sˈɒlvd ˈəʊnəʃˌɪp baɪ kɹiːˈeɪtɪŋ ɐn ɪlˈabəɹət pɹˈɒbləm ɒv stjˈuːədʃˌɪp/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: You still need people to store, inspect and mend what everyone may use.
lines.ipa: /juː stˈɪl nˈiːd pˈiːpəl tə stˈɔː ɪnspˈɛkt and mˈɛnd wɒt ˈɛvɹɪwˌɒn mˈeɪ jˈuːz/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Yes, and calling it communal doesn't make those hours distribute themselves.
lines.ipa: /jˈɛs and kˈɔːlɪŋ ɪt kəmjˈuːnəl dˈʌzənt mˌeɪk ðəʊz ˈaʊəz dˈɪstɹɪbjˌuːt ðɛmsˈɛlvz/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Assign and support that work explicitly. Shared access isn't the same as shared responsibility.
lines.ipa: /ɐsˈaɪn and səpˈɔːt ðat wˈɜːk ɛksplˈɪsɪtli ʃˈeəd ˈaksɛs ˌɪzənt ðə sˈeɪm az ʃˈeəd ɹɪspˌɒnsəbˈɪlɪti/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: The plastic-free event imported heavy replacement containers that nobody expects to use again.
lines.ipa: /ðə plˈastɪkfɹˈiː ɪvˈɛnt ɪmpˈɔːtɪd hˈɛvi ɹɪplˈeɪsmənt kəntˈeɪnəz ðat nˈəʊbɒdi ɛkspˈɛkts tə jˈuːz ɐɡˈɛn/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: A visible material was eliminated while the less visible consequences escaped the brief.
lines.ipa: /ɐ vˈɪzɪbəl mətˈiəɹiəl wɒz ɪlˈɪmɪnˌeɪtɪd wˌaɪl ðə lˈɛs vˈɪzɪbəl kˈɒnsɪkwənsɪz ɛskˈeɪpt ðə bɹˈiːf/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: The organisers genuinely meant to improve things.
lines.ipa: /ðɪ ˈɔːɡɐnˌaɪzəz dʒˈɛnjuːɪnli mˈɛnt tʊ ɪmpɹˈuːv θˈɪŋz/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Then the review should help them examine the whole arrangement, rather than reward an intention with an unqualified success story.
lines.ipa: /ðˈɛn ðə ɹɪvjˈuː ʃˌʊd hˈɛlp ðˌɛm ɛɡzˈamɪn ðə hˈəʊl ɐɹˈeɪndʒmənt ɹˈɑːðə ðɐn ɹɪwˈɔːd ɐn ɪntˈɛnʃən wɪð ɐn ʌŋkwˈɒlɪfˌaɪd səksˈɛs stˈɔːɹi/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: The proposed cycle route is praised for attracting confident riders who already cycled.
lines.ipa: /ðə pɹəpˈəʊzd sˈaɪkəl ɹˈuːt ɪz pɹˈeɪzd fɔːɹ ɐtɹˈaktɪŋ kˈɒnfɪdənt ɹˈaɪdəz hˌuː ɔːlɹˌɛdi sˈaɪkəld/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: A result that may say little about widening access.
lines.ipa: /ɐ ɹɪzˈʌlt ðat mˈeɪ sˈeɪ lˈɪtəl ɐbˌaʊt wˈaɪdənɪŋ ˈaksɛs/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Exactly. The missing users are still invisible in the evaluation.
lines.ipa: /ɛɡzˈaktli ðə mˈɪsɪŋ jˈuːzəz ɑː stˈɪl ɪnvˈɪzɪbəl ɪnðɪ ɪvˌaljuːˈeɪʃən/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Ask who could make a journey afterwards that they couldn't comfortably make before.
lines.ipa: /ˈask hˌuː kʊd mˌeɪk ɐ dʒˈɜːni ˈaftəwədz ðat ðeɪ kˌʊdənt kˈʌmftəbli mˌeɪk bɪfˈɔː/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: The consultation summary calls the quieter responses broadly supportive, though several contain careful objections.
lines.ipa: /ðə kɒnsəltˈeɪʃən sˈʌməɹi kˈɔːlz ðə kwˈaɪətə ɹɪspˈɒnsɪz bɹˈɔːdli səpˈɔːtɪv ðˌəʊ sˈɛvɹəl kəntˈeɪn kˈeəfəl ɒbdʒˈɛkʃənz/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Their courtesy may have been mistaken for consent.
lines.ipa: /ðeə kˈɜːtəsi mˌeɪhɐv bˌiːn mɪstˈeɪkən fɔː kənsˈɛnt/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: The loudest comments were categorised more accurately, if less sympathetically.
lines.ipa: /ðə lˈaʊdɪst kˈɒmɛnts wɜː kˈatɪɡəɹˌaɪzd mˈɔːɹ ˈakjʊɹətli ɪf lˈɛs sˌɪmpəθˈɛtɪkli/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Read the substance independently of the tone. Restraint shouldn't make a disagreement disappear.
lines.ipa: /ɹˈiːd ðə sˈʌbstəns ˌɪndɪpˈɛndəntli ɒvðə tˈəʊn ɹɪstɹˈeɪnt ʃˌʊdənt mˌeɪk ɐ dˌɪsɐɡɹˈiːmənt dˌɪsɐpˈiə/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: The budget process is transparent enough for everyone to see the decision, but not to follow how it was reached.
lines.ipa: /ðə bˈʌdʒɪt pɹˈəʊsɛs ɪz tɹanspˈaɹənt ɪnˈʌf fɔːɹ ˈɛvɹɪwˌɒn tə sˈiː ðə dɪsˈɪʒən bˌʌt nˌɒt tə fˈɒləʊ hˌaʊ ɪt wɒz ɹˈiːtʃt/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Visibility without intelligibility.
lines.ipa: /vˌɪzɪbˈɪlɪti wɪðˌaʊt ɪntˌɛlɪdʒəbˈɪlɪti/

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: There's a table of scores, yet the weighting is unexplained.
lines.ipa: /ðeəz ɐ tˈeɪbəl ɒv skˈɔːz jˈɛt ðə wˈeɪtɪŋ ɪz ˌʌnɛksplˈeɪnd/

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Then publish the reasoning that connects the numbers to the outcome. Displaying a calculation isn't the same as making it accountable.
lines.ipa: /ðˈɛn pˈʌblɪʃ ðə ɹˈiːzənɪŋ ðat kənˈɛkts ðə nˈʌmbəz tə ðɪ ˈaʊtkʌm dɪsplˈeɪɪŋ ɐ kˌalkjʊlˈeɪʃən ˌɪzənt ðə sˈeɪm az mˌeɪkɪŋ ɪt ɐkˈaʊntəbəl/
